# PPIQ T-042 S6a - THE PROJECTION AUTHORITY, AND THE RESURRECTION DEFECT. REVISION S6a.
# Seven fragments in the page endpoint, one numbered script, one manifest row,
# one replay entry.
#
# THE DEFECT THIS EXISTS TO PREVENT, and my own projection design would have
# shipped it: a published page is soft-deleted, /pages stops returning it, its
# backing dashboard loses its join, the projection reads it as a seeded
# workspace, and the deleted page RESURRECTS in navigation under the dashboard's
# name. So the projection must be able to tell a dashboard that NEVER had a page
# from one whose page was deleted - which means seeing the deleted rows, and
# only for that purpose. The Page Builder listing keeps the default and never
# sees them.
#
# DELETE CLEARS THE PUBLICATION AND KEEPS THE BACKING RELATION. The relation is
# the only thing that stops the orphaned dashboard from later passing as seeded,
# so "cleaning it up" would reintroduce exactly the defect above.
#
# ONE LIVE PAGE PER BACKING DASHBOARD, enforced by a partial unique index rather
# than by the client picking the first match. Two authored labels on one
# workspace is a guess dressed as a projection.
#
#   .\tools\packs\apply-T-042-S6a-projection-authority.ps1 -ReportOnly
#   .\tools\packs\apply-T-042-S6a-projection-authority.ps1
#   .\tools\packs\apply-T-042-S6a-projection-authority.ps1 -Revert

function Say([string]$m) { Write-Host $m }
function Line() { Write-Host "------------------------------------------------------------" }
function ReadTextFile([string]$p) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p) }
function ToLf([string]$t) { return ($t -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`r", "`n" }
function IsCrlf([string]$t) { return $t.Contains("`r`n") }

function StripSqlComments([string]$t) {
    $keep = @()
    foreach ($l in ($t -split "`n")) { $keep += ($l -replace "--.*$", "") }
    return ($keep -join "`n")
}

function WriteTextFile([string]$p, [string]$lfText, [bool]$crlf) {
    $out = $lfText
    if ($crlf) { $out = $lfText -replace "`n", "`r`n" }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $out, $enc)
}

function CountOf([string]$hay, [string]$needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($needle)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle)
    while ($i -ge 0) { $n = $n + 1; $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle, $i + $needle.Length) }
    return $n
}

-- PPIQ T-042 S6 - ONE PAGE, ONE BACKING WORKSPACE

--
-- Two live pages claiming the same backing dashboard would give one workspace

# PPIQ T-042 S6b - PUBLISH, THE FAIL-CLOSED PROJECTION, AND IMMEDIATE REFRESH. REVISION S6b.
# One NEW module, ten fragments across three files. No backend change.
#
# THE PROJECTION IS SUBTRACTIVE AND FAILS CLOSED. A dashboard no page ever
# claimed is a seeded workspace and is preserved exactly as it is. A dashboard a
# page claimed is shown only when that page is published, not deleted, and its
# audience contains the current role - labelled with the title the AUTHOR gave.
#
# If the page list cannot be read, "there are no PageBuilder pages" is NOT
# assumed: that would classify every backed dashboard as seeded and expose
# unpublished drafts. The last known-good links stand and nothing changes.
#
# NO ADMIN BYPASS IS INVENTED. AuthenticatedUser carries ONE role string, so a
# page whose audience is Engineer is invisible to an Admin. That is the M1
# contract, stated in the code rather than quietly widened.
#
# REFRESH IS INVALIDATION ONLY - one event name in one module, carrying no page
# data and no cache, fired only AFTER the server confirms a publish, unpublish
# or delete. Firing on intent would put a workspace in navigation that the
# server refused.
#
#   .\tools\packs\apply-T-042-S6b-publish-and-projection.ps1 -ReportOnly
#   .\tools\packs\apply-T-042-S6b-publish-and-projection.ps1
#   .\tools\packs\apply-T-042-S6b-publish-and-projection.ps1 -Revert

function Say([string]$m) { Write-Host $m }
function Line() { Write-Host "------------------------------------------------------------" }
function ReadTextFile([string]$p) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p) }
function ToLf([string]$t) { return ($t -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`r", "`n" }
function IsCrlf([string]$t) { return $t.Contains("`r`n") }

function StripComments([string]$t) {
    $keep = @()
    foreach ($l in ($t -split "`n")) {
        if ($l.Trim().StartsWith("///")) { continue }
        $keep += ($l -replace "//.*$", "")
    }
    return ($keep -join "`n")
}

function WriteTextFile([string]$p, [string]$lfText, [bool]$crlf) {
    $out = $lfText
    if ($crlf) { $out = $lfText -replace "`n", "`r`n" }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $out, $enc)
}

function CountOf([string]$hay, [string]$needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($needle)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle)
    while ($i -ge 0) { $n = $n + 1; $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle, $i + $needle.Length) }
    return $n
}

$SignalText = @'
/// PPIQ T-042 S6. ONE NAME, ONE PLACE.
///
/// Navigation is built once when AppLayout mounts, and AppLayout stays mounted
/// while an author publishes a page. Without an explicit signal a successful
/// Publish would be invisible until a browser reload, which is not the contract.
///
/// This is INVALIDATION ONLY. It carries no page data, keeps no cache and owns
/// no state: it says "the set of visible workspaces may have changed, ask the
/// server again". Anything more would be a second copy of data that already has
/// one authority.
export const WORKSPACE_LINKS_CHANGED = "ppiq:workspaces-changed";

/// Fired only AFTER a server mutation has been confirmed. Firing on intent
/// rather than on confirmation would show a workspace the server never
/// published.
export function notifyWorkspaceLinksChanged(): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return;
  }

  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(WORKSPACE_LINKS_CHANGED));
}

export function subscribeToWorkspaceLinksChanged(listener: () => void): () => void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return () => undefined;
  }

  window.addEventListener(WORKSPACE_LINKS_CHANGED, listener);

  return () => window.removeEventListener(WORKSPACE_LINKS_CHANGED, listener);
}

function useWorkspaceLinks(): NavEntry[] {
  const [links, setLinks] = useState<NavEntry[]>([]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let ignore = false;
    apiClient
      .get<unknown>("/analytics/dashboard/definitions")
      .then((body) => {
        if (ignore) return;
        const container = body as Record<string, unknown> | unknown[] | null;
        const arr = Array.isArray(container)
          ? container
          : ((container?.["items"] ??
              container?.["definitions"] ??
              container?.["dashboards"] ??
              container?.["results"] ??
              []) as unknown[]);
        const mapped = (arr as Array<Record<string, unknown>>)
          .map((d) => ({
            code: String(d["dashboardCode"] ?? d["dashboard_code"] ?? d["code"] ?? ""),
            name: String(d["name"] ?? d["dashboardCode"] ?? d["code"] ?? "Workspace"),

        setLinks(mapped);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (ignore) return;
        console.warn("[nav] workspace list unavailable:", err);
        setLinks([]);
      });
    return () => { ignore = true; };
  }, []);
  return links;
}
'@
$N2Old = ToLf($N2Old)
$N2New = @'
function useWorkspaceLinks(): NavEntry[] {
  const [links, setLinks] = useState<NavEntry[]>([]);
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const role = user?.role ?? "";

  useEffect(() => {
    let ignore = false;

    async function load() {
      // PPIQ T-042 S6. TWO AUTHORITIES, AND THE PROJECTION FAILS CLOSED.
      //
      // Navigation now depends on the dashboards AND on page lifecycle. If the
      // page list cannot be read, "there are no PageBuilder pages" is NOT a
      // safe assumption - it would classify every backed dashboard as seeded
      // and expose unpublished drafts. So a failed page fetch keeps whatever
      // was last known good and changes nothing.
      const dashboards = await apiClient.get<unknown>("/analytics/dashboard/definitions");
      const pages = await pageBuilderApi.listMine(true);

      if (ignore) {
        return;
      }

      const container = dashboards as Record<string, unknown> | unknown[] | null;
      const arr = Array.isArray(container)
        ? container
        : ((container?.["items"] ??
            container?.["definitions"] ??
            container?.["dashboards"] ??
            container?.["results"] ??
            []) as unknown[]);

      const byDashboard = new Map<string, PageDefinitionDto>();

      for (const page of pages) {
        if (page.backingDashboardDefinitionId) {
          byDashboard.set(String(page.backingDashboardDefinitionId).toLowerCase(), page);
        }
      }

      const mapped = (arr as Array<Record<string, unknown>>)
        .map((d) => ({
          id: String(d["id"] ?? d["dashboardDefinitionId"] ?? "").toLowerCase(),
          code: String(d["dashboardCode"] ?? d["dashboard_code"] ?? d["code"] ?? ""),
          name: String(d["name"] ?? d["dashboardCode"] ?? d["code"] ?? "Workspace"),
        }))
        .filter((d) => d.code)
        .map((d) => {
          const owner = byDashboard.get(d.id);

          // No page ever claimed this dashboard: a seeded or system workspace,
          // preserved exactly as it was, labelled by the dashboard.
          if (!owner) {
            return d;
          }

          // A page claimed it and was deleted. This is the resurrection case:
          // the dashboard is orphaned, NOT seeded, and must stay hidden.
          if (owner.isDeleted === true) {
            return null;
          }

          // A draft is not a workspace.
          if (!owner.publishedAtUtc) {
            return null;
          }

          // Published to an audience this role is not in. One role string is
          // all the auth contract carries, so it is compared exactly - there is
          // deliberately no Admin bypass invented here.
          const audience = Array.isArray(owner.audienceRoles) ? owner.audienceRoles : [];

          if (!audience.includes(role)) {
            return null;
          }

          // Shown once, under the name the AUTHOR gave the page.
          return { id: d.id, code: d.code, name: owner.title };
        })
        .filter((d): d is { id: string; code: string; name: string } => d !== null)
        .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
        .map((d) => ({
          to: "/workspace/" + d.code,
          label: d.name,
          desc: "Interactive analytics workspace",
          icon: LayoutDashboard,
        }));

      setLinks(mapped);
    }

    load().catch((err) => {
      if (ignore) return;
      // Fail closed: the previous links stand. Replacing them with every
      // dashboard would publish drafts by accident.
      console.warn("[nav] workspace projection unavailable, keeping the last known list:", err);
    });

    const unsubscribe = subscribeToWorkspaceLinksChanged(() => {
      load().catch(() => undefined);
    });

    return () => {
      ignore = true;
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [role]);

  return links;
}

# PPIQ T-042 S6b - PUBLISH, THE FAIL-CLOSED PROJECTION, AND IMMEDIATE REFRESH. REVISION S6c.
# One NEW module, twelve fragments across five files. No backend change.
#
# WHY S6c: the page now reads the current role, so useAuth runs on every render -
# and the thirteen existing Page Builder proofs render it BARE, outside an
# AuthProvider. The product is right and my tests never provided the context.
# Two more fragments give both test files the same auth mock they already give
# the API modules.
#
# THE PROJECTION IS SUBTRACTIVE AND FAILS CLOSED. A dashboard no page ever
# claimed is a seeded workspace and is preserved exactly as it is. A dashboard a
# page claimed is shown only when that page is published, not deleted, and its
# audience contains the current role - labelled with the title the AUTHOR gave.
#
# If the page list cannot be read, "there are no PageBuilder pages" is NOT
# assumed: that would classify every backed dashboard as seeded and expose
# unpublished drafts. The last known-good links stand and nothing changes.
#
# NO ADMIN BYPASS IS INVENTED. AuthenticatedUser carries ONE role string, so a
# page whose audience is Engineer is invisible to an Admin. That is the M1
# contract, stated in the code rather than quietly widened.
#
# REFRESH IS INVALIDATION ONLY - one event name in one module, carrying no page
# data and no cache, fired only AFTER the server confirms a publish, unpublish
# or delete. Firing on intent would put a workspace in navigation that the
# server refused.
#
#   .\tools\packs\apply-T-042-S6c-publish-and-projection.ps1 -ReportOnly

function Say([string]$m) { Write-Host $m }
function Line() { Write-Host "------------------------------------------------------------" }
function ReadTextFile([string]$p) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p) }
function ToLf([string]$t) { return ($t -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`r", "`n" }
function IsCrlf([string]$t) { return $t.Contains("`r`n") }

function StripComments([string]$t) {
    $keep = @()
    foreach ($l in ($t -split "`n")) {
        if ($l.Trim().StartsWith("///")) { continue }
        $keep += ($l -replace "//.*$", "")
    }
    return ($keep -join "`n")
}

function WriteTextFile([string]$p, [string]$lfText, [bool]$crlf) {
    $out = $lfText
    if ($crlf) { $out = $lfText -replace "`n", "`r`n" }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $out, $enc)
}

function CountOf([string]$hay, [string]$needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($needle)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle)
    while ($i -ge 0) { $n = $n + 1; $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle, $i + $needle.Length) }
    return $n
}

$SignalText = @'
/// PPIQ T-042 S6. ONE NAME, ONE PLACE.
///
/// Navigation is built once when AppLayout mounts, and AppLayout stays mounted
/// while an author publishes a page. Without an explicit signal a successful
/// Publish would be invisible until a browser reload, which is not the contract.
///
/// This is INVALIDATION ONLY. It carries no page data, keeps no cache and owns
/// no state: it says "the set of visible workspaces may have changed, ask the
/// server again". Anything more would be a second copy of data that already has
/// one authority.
export const WORKSPACE_LINKS_CHANGED = "ppiq:workspaces-changed";

/// Fired only AFTER a server mutation has been confirmed. Firing on intent
/// rather than on confirmation would show a workspace the server never
/// published.
export function notifyWorkspaceLinksChanged(): void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return;
  }

  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(WORKSPACE_LINKS_CHANGED));
}

export function subscribeToWorkspaceLinksChanged(listener: () => void): () => void {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
    return () => undefined;
  }

  window.addEventListener(WORKSPACE_LINKS_CHANGED, listener);

  return () => window.removeEventListener(WORKSPACE_LINKS_CHANGED, listener);
}

function useWorkspaceLinks(): NavEntry[] {
  const [links, setLinks] = useState<NavEntry[]>([]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let ignore = false;
    apiClient
      .get<unknown>("/analytics/dashboard/definitions")
      .then((body) => {
        if (ignore) return;
        const container = body as Record<string, unknown> | unknown[] | null;
        const arr = Array.isArray(container)
          ? container
          : ((container?.["items"] ??
              container?.["definitions"] ??
              container?.["dashboards"] ??
              container?.["results"] ??
              []) as unknown[]);
        const mapped = (arr as Array<Record<string, unknown>>)
          .map((d) => ({
            code: String(d["dashboardCode"] ?? d["dashboard_code"] ?? d["code"] ?? ""),

      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (ignore) return;
        console.warn("[nav] workspace list unavailable:", err);
        setLinks([]);
      });
    return () => { ignore = true; };
  }, []);
  return links;

function useWorkspaceLinks(): NavEntry[] {
  const [links, setLinks] = useState<NavEntry[]>([]);
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const role = user?.role ?? "";

  useEffect(() => {
    let ignore = false;

    async function load() {
      // PPIQ T-042 S6. TWO AUTHORITIES, AND THE PROJECTION FAILS CLOSED.
      //
      // Navigation now depends on the dashboards AND on page lifecycle. If the
      // page list cannot be read, "there are no PageBuilder pages" is NOT a
      // safe assumption - it would classify every backed dashboard as seeded
      // and expose unpublished drafts. So a failed page fetch keeps whatever
      // was last known good and changes nothing.
      const dashboards = await apiClient.get<unknown>("/analytics/dashboard/definitions");
      const pages = await pageBuilderApi.listMine(true);

      if (ignore) {
        return;
      }

      const container = dashboards as Record<string, unknown> | unknown[] | null;
      const arr = Array.isArray(container)
        ? container
        : ((container?.["items"] ??
            container?.["definitions"] ??
            container?.["dashboards"] ??
            container?.["results"] ??
            []) as unknown[]);

      const byDashboard = new Map<string, PageDefinitionDto>();

      for (const page of pages) {
        if (page.backingDashboardDefinitionId) {
          byDashboard.set(String(page.backingDashboardDefinitionId).toLowerCase(), page);
        }
      }

      const mapped = (arr as Array<Record<string, unknown>>)
        .map((d) => ({
          id: String(d["id"] ?? d["dashboardDefinitionId"] ?? "").toLowerCase(),
          code: String(d["dashboardCode"] ?? d["dashboard_code"] ?? d["code"] ?? ""),
          name: String(d["name"] ?? d["dashboardCode"] ?? d["code"] ?? "Workspace"),
        }))
        .filter((d) => d.code)
        .map((d) => {
          const owner = byDashboard.get(d.id);

          // No page ever claimed this dashboard: a seeded or system workspace,
          // preserved exactly as it was, labelled by the dashboard.
          if (!owner) {
            return d;
          }

          // A page claimed it and was deleted. This is the resurrection case:
          // the dashboard is orphaned, NOT seeded, and must stay hidden.
          if (owner.isDeleted === true) {
            return null;
          }

          // A draft is not a workspace.
          if (!owner.publishedAtUtc) {
            return null;
          }

          // Published to an audience this role is not in. One role string is
          // all the auth contract carries, so it is compared exactly - there is
          // deliberately no Admin bypass invented here.
          const audience = Array.isArray(owner.audienceRoles) ? owner.audienceRoles : [];

          if (!audience.includes(role)) {
            return null;
          }

          // Shown once, under the name the AUTHOR gave the page.
          return { id: d.id, code: d.code, name: owner.title };
        })
        .filter((d): d is { id: string; code: string; name: string } => d !== null)
        .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
        .map((d) => ({
          to: "/workspace/" + d.code,
          label: d.name,
          desc: "Interactive analytics workspace",
          icon: LayoutDashboard,
        }));

      setLinks(mapped);
    }

    load().catch((err) => {
      if (ignore) return;
      // Fail closed: the previous links stand. Replacing them with every
      // dashboard would publish drafts by accident.
      console.warn("[nav] workspace projection unavailable, keeping the last known list:", err);
    });

    const unsubscribe = subscribeToWorkspaceLinksChanged(() => {
      load().catch(() => undefined);
    });

    return () => {
      ignore = true;
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [role]);

  return links;
}

export function PageBuilderPage() {

function Say([string]$m) { Write-Host $m }
function Line() { Write-Host "------------------------------------------------------------" }
function ReadTextFile([string]$p) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p) }
function ToLf([string]$t) { return ($t -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`r", "`n" }
function IsCrlf([string]$t) { return $t.Contains("`r`n") }

function StripComments([string]$t) {
    $keep = @()
    foreach ($l in ($t -split "`n")) {
        if ($l.Trim().StartsWith("///")) { continue }
        $keep += ($l -replace "//.*$", "")
    }
    return ($keep -join "`n")
}

function WriteTextFile([string]$p, [string]$lfText, [bool]$crlf) {
    $out = $lfText
    if ($crlf) { $out = $lfText -replace "`n", "`r`n" }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $out, $enc)
}

function CountOf([string]$hay, [string]$needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($needle)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle)
    while ($i -ge 0) { $n = $n + 1; $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle, $i + $needle.Length) }
    return $n
}

function useWorkspaceLinks(): NavEntry[] {
'@
$E1Old = ToLf($E1Old)

/// PPIQ T-042 S6. Exported for its proofs. Navigation classification decides
/// what a customer can see, its most important rule is a NEGATIVE one, and the
/// case that matters most - a published page deleted, its dashboard still
/// present - cannot be reached by clicking. It has to be reachable to be proved.
export function useWorkspaceLinks(): NavEntry[] {
'@
$E1New = ToLf($E1New)

// PPIQ T-042 S6 - THE WORKSPACE PROJECTION.
//
// Seven classification cases and one invalidation case. The projection decides
// what appears in a customer's navigation, so its failures are not cosmetic:
// showing a draft is a leak, hiding a seeded workspace is a regression, and
// showing a deleted page is the resurrection defect this design was corrected
// to prevent.
//
// The fail-closed proof asserts the PREVIOUS links survive, not merely that the
// result is non-empty. "The authority became unavailable" must never turn into
// "assume no PageBuilder ownership exists".

import { renderHook, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { describe, expect, it, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";

const { api, pageApi } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  api: { get: vi.fn() },
  pageApi: { listMine: vi.fn() },
}));

vi.mock("@/api/http/apiClient", () => ({ apiClient: api, ApiError: class ApiError extends Error {} }));
vi.mock("@/api/pageBuilder", () => ({ pageBuilderApi: pageApi }));
vi.mock("../../state/AuthContext", () => ({ useAuth: () => ({ user: { role: "Engineer" } }) }));

import { useWorkspaceLinks } from "../AppLayout";
import { notifyWorkspaceLinksChanged } from "../../state/workspaceLinksSignal";

const SEEDED = { id: "d-seeded", dashboardCode: "PRODUCTION_OVERVIEW", name: "Production Overview" };
const BACKED = { id: "d-backed", dashboardCode: "PAGE_ABC123", name: "PAGE_ABC123" };

function authoredPage(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return {
    id: "p-1",
    slug: "shift-production",
    title: "Shift production",
    audienceRoles: ["Engineer"],
    backingDashboardDefinitionId: "d-backed",
    publishedAtUtc: "2026-08-08T20:00:00Z",
    isDeleted: false,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function labels(result: { current: Array<{ label: string; to: string }> }) {
  return result.current.map((entry) => entry.label);
}

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  api.get.mockResolvedValue([SEEDED, BACKED]);
  pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([]);
});

describe("T-042 the workspace projection", () => {
  it("1 preserves a seeded dashboard that no page ever claimed", async () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Production Overview"));
  });

  it("2 hides a backed dashboard whose page is still a draft", async () => {
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage({ publishedAtUtc: null })]);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Production Overview"));
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("PAGE_ABC123");
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("Shift production");
  });

  it("3 shows a published page once, under the title its author gave it", async () => {
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage()]);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Shift production"));
    expect(labels(result).filter((label) => label === "Shift production")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("PAGE_ABC123");
    expect(result.current.find((entry) => entry.label === "Shift production")?.to)
      .toBe("/workspace/PAGE_ABC123");
  });

  it("4 hides a published page whose audience does not contain this exact role", async () => {
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage({ audienceRoles: ["Admin"] })]);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Production Overview"));
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("Shift production");
  });

  it("5 shows a published page whose audience contains this role", async () => {
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage({ audienceRoles: ["Viewer", "Engineer"] })]);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Shift production"));
  });

  it("6 keeps a deleted page's dashboard hidden - it must not resurrect as seeded", async () => {
    // Published, then deleted. The dashboard is still there and the page still
    // owns it; without the deleted row in the projection this would come back
    // as a seeded workspace under its dashboard code.
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage({ isDeleted: true })]);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Production Overview"));
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("Shift production");
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("PAGE_ABC123");
  });

  it("7 fails closed: a page-fetch failure leaves the previous links exactly as they were", async () => {
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage()]);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Shift production"));

    const knownGood = labels(result);

    // The page authority goes away. It must NOT be read as "no PageBuilder
    // pages exist", which would expose every backed dashboard.
    pageApi.listMine.mockRejectedValue(new Error("page authority unavailable"));
    notifyWorkspaceLinksChanged();

    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));

    expect(labels(result)).toEqual(knownGood);
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("PAGE_ABC123");
  });

  it("8 refreshes navigation when the shared signal fires, with no reload", async () => {
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage({ publishedAtUtc: null })]);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Production Overview"));
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("Shift production");

    const before = pageApi.listMine.mock.calls.length;

    // The server state changes - this is what Publish leaves behind.
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage()]);
    notifyWorkspaceLinksChanged();

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Shift production"));
    expect(pageApi.listMine.mock.calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(before);
  });
});

# PPIQ T-042 S7 - THE WORKSPACE PROJECTION PROVED. REVISION S7.
# ONE new test file and ONE product fragment: the hook becomes exported.
#
# WHY THE EXPORT IS NOT TEST-DRIVEN DESIGN FOR ITS OWN SAKE. This hook decides
# what a customer sees in navigation, its most important rule is a NEGATIVE one,
# and the case that matters most - a page published, then deleted, its dashboard
# still present - cannot be reached by clicking. Unreachable code with a
# negative contract is exactly the code that should not be trusted untested.
#
# EIGHT PROOFS. Seven classification cases and one behavioural invalidation case
# proving that RECEIVING the signal actually refetches - the product self-check
# only proved the mutation sites DISPATCH it, and those are different claims.
#
# THE FAIL-CLOSED PROOF ASSERTS THE PREVIOUS LINKS SURVIVE, not merely that the
# result is non-empty. "The authority became unavailable" must never become
# "assume no PageBuilder ownership exists", which would publish every draft.
#
#   .\tools\packs\apply-T-042-S7-projection-proofs.ps1 -ReportOnly
#   .\tools\packs\apply-T-042-S7-projection-proofs.ps1

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

function Say([string]$m) { Write-Host $m }
function Line() { Write-Host "------------------------------------------------------------" }
function ReadTextFile([string]$p) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p) }
function ToLf([string]$t) { return ($t -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`r", "`n" }
function IsCrlf([string]$t) { return $t.Contains("`r`n") }

function StripComments([string]$t) {
    $keep = @()
    foreach ($l in ($t -split "`n")) {
        if ($l.Trim().StartsWith("///")) { continue }
        $keep += ($l -replace "//.*$", "")
    }
    return ($keep -join "`n")
}

function WriteTextFile([string]$p, [string]$lfText, [bool]$crlf) {
    $out = $lfText
    if ($crlf) { $out = $lfText -replace "`n", "`r`n" }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $out, $enc)
}

function CountOf([string]$hay, [string]$needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($needle)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle)
    while ($i -ge 0) { $n = $n + 1; $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle, $i + $needle.Length) }
    return $n
}

//

import { renderHook, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { describe, expect, it, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";

const { api, pageApi } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  api: { get: vi.fn() },
  pageApi: { listMine: vi.fn() },
}));

vi.mock("@/api/http/apiClient", () => ({ apiClient: api, ApiError: class ApiError extends Error {} }));
vi.mock("@/api/pageBuilder", () => ({ pageBuilderApi: pageApi }));
vi.mock("../../state/AuthContext", () => ({ useAuth: () => ({ user: { role: "Engineer" } }) }));

import { useWorkspaceLinks } from "../AppLayout";
import { notifyWorkspaceLinksChanged } from "../../state/workspaceLinksSignal";

const SEEDED = { id: "d-seeded", dashboardCode: "PRODUCTION_OVERVIEW", name: "Production Overview" };
const BACKED = { id: "d-backed", dashboardCode: "PAGE_ABC123", name: "PAGE_ABC123" };

function authoredPage(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return {
    id: "p-1",
    slug: "shift-production",
    title: "Shift production",
    audienceRoles: ["Engineer"],
    backingDashboardDefinitionId: "d-backed",
    publishedAtUtc: "2026-08-08T20:00:00Z",
    isDeleted: false,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function labels(result: { current: Array<{ label: string; to: string }> }) {
  return result.current.map((entry) => entry.label);
}

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  api.get.mockResolvedValue([SEEDED, BACKED]);
  pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([]);
});

describe("T-042 the workspace projection", () => {
  it("1 preserves a seeded dashboard that no page ever claimed", async () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Production Overview"));
  });

  it("2 hides a backed dashboard whose page is still a draft", async () => {
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage({ publishedAtUtc: null })]);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Production Overview"));
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("PAGE_ABC123");
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("Shift production");
  });

  it("3 shows a published page once, under the title its author gave it", async () => {
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage()]);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Shift production"));
    expect(labels(result).filter((label) => label === "Shift production")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("PAGE_ABC123");
    expect(result.current.find((entry) => entry.label === "Shift production")?.to)
      .toBe("/workspace/PAGE_ABC123");
  });

  it("4 hides a published page whose audience does not contain this exact role", async () => {
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage({ audienceRoles: ["Admin"] })]);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Production Overview"));
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("Shift production");
  });

  it("5 shows a published page whose audience contains this role", async () => {
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage({ audienceRoles: ["Viewer", "Engineer"] })]);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Shift production"));
  });

  it("6 keeps a deleted page's dashboard hidden - it must not resurrect as seeded", async () => {
    // Published, then deleted. The dashboard is still there and the page still
    // owns it; without the deleted row in the projection this would come back
    // as a seeded workspace under its dashboard code.
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage({ isDeleted: true })]);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Production Overview"));
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("Shift production");
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("PAGE_ABC123");
  });

  it("7 fails closed: a page-fetch failure leaves the previous links exactly as they were", async () => {
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage()]);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Shift production"));

    const knownGood = labels(result);

    // The page authority goes away. It must NOT be read as "no PageBuilder
    // pages exist", which would expose every backed dashboard.
    pageApi.listMine.mockRejectedValue(new Error("page authority unavailable"));
    notifyWorkspaceLinksChanged();

    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));

    expect(labels(result)).toEqual(knownGood);
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("PAGE_ABC123");
  });

  it("8 refreshes navigation when the shared signal fires, with no reload", async () => {
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage({ publishedAtUtc: null })]);

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useWorkspaceLinks());

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Production Overview"));
    expect(labels(result)).not.toContain("Shift production");

    const before = pageApi.listMine.mock.calls.length;

    // The server state changes - this is what Publish leaves behind.
    pageApi.listMine.mockResolvedValue([authoredPage()]);
    notifyWorkspaceLinksChanged();

    await waitFor(() => expect(labels(result)).toContain("Shift production"));
    expect(pageApi.listMine.mock.calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(before);
  });
});

# PPIQ T-042 S8 - THE FINAL BROWSER ACCEPTANCE. REVISION S8.
# ONE fragment appended to the existing t041 spec. No new config, no new runner,
# no new evidence folder - the T-040 harness, reused as it is.
#
# TWO FLOWS, both frozen acceptance lines:
#
#   1. Create a page, author TWO REAL widgets through the shared shell, confirm
#      the grid carries the SERVER's identities and not generated ones, move one
#      and resize the other, save, HARD RELOAD, and compare the geometry value
#      by value. Then Publish and read navigation IN THE SAME CONTEXT - a reload
#      there would prove nothing about invalidation, which is the whole point of
#      that assertion. Then open the real backing workspace.
#
#   2. A separate draft that is never published, never appears in Workspaces,
#      and after deletion leaves no orphan entry behind.
#
# The shell needs exactly three things before it saves, from
# widgetDefinitionModel.saveRefusal: a title, a chart type, and a dimension or a
# measure. Each option is whatever the endpoint published FIRST - nothing about
# a reference plant is named anywhere in this flow.
#
# The page slug carries a timestamp so a rerun never collides with the page the
# previous run published.
#
#   .\tools\packs\apply-T-042-S8-browser-acceptance.ps1 -ReportOnly
#   .\tools\packs\apply-T-042-S8-browser-acceptance.ps1
#   .\tools\packs\apply-T-042-S8-browser-acceptance.ps1 -Revert

param([switch]$ReportOnly, [switch]$Revert)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
$Rev = "T-042-S8"

function Say([string]$m) { Write-Host $m }
function Line() { Write-Host "------------------------------------------------------------" }
function ReadTextFile([string]$p) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p) }
function ToLf([string]$t) { return ($t -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`r", "`n" }
function IsCrlf([string]$t) { return $t.Contains("`r`n") }

function StripComments([string]$t) {
    $keep = @()
    foreach ($l in ($t -split "`n")) { $keep += ($l -replace "//.*$", "") }
    return ($keep -join "`n")
}

function WriteTextFile([string]$p, [string]$lfText, [bool]$crlf) {
    $out = $lfText
    if ($crlf) { $out = $lfText -replace "`n", "`r`n" }
    $enc = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $out, $enc)
}

function CountOf([string]$hay, [string]$needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($needle)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle)
    while ($i -ge 0) { $n = $n + 1; $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle, $i + $needle.Length) }
    return $n
}

test.describe("T-042 the page lifecycle, end to end", () => {
  // One flow, deliberately. Every step is a frozen acceptance line, and each
  // one is asserted on what the SERVER gave back rather than on what the client
  // hoped: the widget identities come from the persisted list, the geometry is
  // compared value by value after a real reload, and the navigation entry is
  // read WITHOUT reloading, because a reload would prove nothing about
  // invalidation.
  const stamp = Date.now().toString(36);
  const pageTitle = "Shift production " + stamp;
  const pageSlug = "shift-production-" + stamp;

  async function fillPageMeta(page: Page, title: string, slug: string) {
    await page.getByLabel("Title").fill(title);
    await page.getByLabel("Slug").fill(slug);
    await page.getByTestId("page-audience").getByLabel("Engineer").check();
  }

  // The shell needs exactly three things before it will save, from
  // widgetDefinitionModel.saveRefusal: a title, a chart type, and a dimension
  // or a measure. Nothing here is invented - each option is whatever the
  // endpoint published first.
  async function authorOneWidget(page: Page, widgetTitle: string) {
    await page.getByTestId("widget-kind-chart").click();
    await page.getByLabel("Widget name").fill(widgetTitle);
    await page.getByTestId("ctl-open-authoring").click();

    const shell = page.getByTestId("authoring-shell");
    await expect(shell).toBeVisible({ timeout: 45_000 });
    await expect(shell).toHaveAttribute("data-purpose", "S2");

    await page.getByLabel("Definition name").fill(widgetTitle);

    const chartType = page.getByLabel("Chart type");
    await chartType.selectOption({ index: 1 });

    const dimension = page.getByLabel("Dimension");
    if (await dimension.count() > 0) {
      await dimension.selectOption({ index: 1 });
    } else {
      await page.getByLabel("Measure").selectOption({ index: 1 });
    }

    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save widget" }).click();
    await expect(shell).toHaveCount(0, { timeout: 45_000 });
  }

  function cards(page: Page) {
    return page.locator("[data-widget-id]");
  }

  async function geometry(page: Page) {
    return page.locator("[data-widget-id]").evaluateAll((nodes) =>
      nodes
        .map((node) => ({
          id: node.getAttribute("data-widget-id") ?? "",
          text: (node.textContent ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim(),
        }))
        .sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)),
    );
  }

  test("two real widgets survive a hard reload, and Publish reaches Workspaces without one", async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto("/page-builder");
    await expect(page.getByLabel("Title")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 45_000 });

    await fillPageMeta(page, pageTitle, pageSlug);

    await authorOneWidget(page, "Yield by grade");
    await expect(cards(page)).toHaveCount(1, { timeout: 30_000 });

    await authorOneWidget(page, "Downtime by line");
    await expect(cards(page)).toHaveCount(2, { timeout: 30_000 });

    // The identities on the grid are the SERVER's, not generated ones.
    const identities = await cards(page).evaluateAll((nodes) =>
      nodes.map((node) => node.getAttribute("data-widget-id") ?? "").sort(),
    );
    expect(identities.filter((id) => id.startsWith("w-"))).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(new Set(identities).size).toBe(2);

    await capture(page, "T-042", "T042-two-real-widgets",
      "Two widgets authored through the shared shell, on the grid under their server-persisted identities.");

    // Arrange: one moved, one resized.
    const first = cards(page).first();
    const second = cards(page).nth(1);
    await first.getByText("Move right").click();
    await second.getByText("Resize wider").click();

    await page.getByTestId("ctl-save-page").click();
    await expect(page.getByRole("status")).toContainText(/Saved|saved/, { timeout: 30_000 });

    const before = await geometry(page);
    expect(before).toHaveLength(2);

    // HARD RELOAD. Not a client re-render.
    await page.reload();
    await expect(page.getByLabel("Title")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 45_000 });
    await page.getByLabel("Slug").fill(pageSlug);
    await page.getByText("Load by slug").click();
    await expect(page.getByRole("status")).toContainText(/Loaded PageDefinition/, { timeout: 30_000 });

    const after = await geometry(page);
    expect(after).toEqual(before);

    await capture(page, "T-042", "T042-layout-survives-reload",
      "After a hard reload the same two persisted identities return with identical normalised geometry.");

    // Publish, then read navigation in the SAME context. A reload here would
    // prove nothing about invalidation.
    await page.getByTestId("ctl-publish-page").click();
    await expect(page.getByRole("status")).toContainText(/Published/, { timeout: 30_000 });

    const navEntry = page.getByRole("link", { name: pageTitle });
    await expect(navEntry).toHaveCount(1, { timeout: 30_000 });

    await capture(page, "T-042", "T042-published-appears-once",
      "Publish put the page into Workspaces during the same session, once, under its authored title.");

    await navEntry.click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/workspace\//, { timeout: 30_000 });
    await expect(page.getByText("Yield by grade")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 45_000 });

    await capture(page, "T-042", "T042-workspace-opens",
      "The authored page opens its real backing workspace with the authored widgets on it.");
  });

  test("an unpublished draft never reaches Workspaces, and delete leaves no orphan", async ({ page }) => {
    const draftTitle = "Draft only " + stamp;
    const draftSlug = "draft-only-" + stamp;

    await page.goto("/page-builder");
    await expect(page.getByLabel("Title")).toBeVisible({ timeout: 45_000 });

    await fillPageMeta(page, draftTitle, draftSlug);
    await authorOneWidget(page, "Draft widget");
    await expect(cards(page)).toHaveCount(1, { timeout: 30_000 });

    // Never published, so never a workspace.
    await expect(page.getByRole("link", { name: draftTitle })).toHaveCount(0);

    await page.getByText("Delete owned page").click();
    await expect(page.getByRole("status")).toContainText(/Deleted PageDefinition/, { timeout: 30_000 });

    await expect(page.getByRole("link", { name: draftTitle })).toHaveCount(0);

    await page.getByLabel("Slug").fill(draftSlug);
    await page.getByText("Load by slug").click();
    await expect(page.getByRole("status")).not.toContainText(/Loaded PageDefinition/, { timeout: 30_000 });

    await capture(page, "T-042", "T042-draft-deleted-no-orphan",
      "A draft never appeared in Workspaces, and after deletion it is gone from the Page Builder with no orphan entry left behind.");
  });
});

function CountOf([string]$hay, [string]$needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($needle)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle)

    return $n
}

#   .\tools\packs\apply-T-042-S9b-pages-access-control.ps1 -ReportOnly

$TestText = @'
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Api.IntegrationTests.Security;

/// PPIQ T-042. THE PAGE BUILDER ROUTE FAMILY IS MAPPED, AND STAYS MAPPED.
///
/// The defect this exists to prevent, measured on 09-Aug: /pages carried no
/// matrix entry at all. Deny-by-default refused POST /pages with 403 - the
/// Page Builder could not persist a page - while GET /pages was served
/// ANONYMOUSLY through the ("/", GET, anonymous) fallback. Half-open for reads,
/// shut for writes, and nothing failing loudly enough to notice until an
/// authoring flow tried to save.
///
/// The Matrix is a private static on AccessControlMiddleware - the file is
/// named PlantAccessControl.cs but that is not the type, and I asserted the
/// filename instead of reading the declaration.
///
/// These proofs read the matrix by reflection rather than by starting a host:
/// the question is what the table says, and a table is a better witness than a
/// round trip that could pass for an unrelated reason.
public sealed class PageBuilderRouteAccessControlTests
{
    private static (string Prefix, string[] Methods, string Permission, bool Anonymous)[] Matrix()
    {
        var type = typeof(PlantProcess.Api.Security.AccessControlMiddleware);
        var field = type.GetField("Matrix", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static);

        Assert.NotNull(field);

        return ((string Prefix, string[] Methods, string Permission, bool Anonymous)[])field!.GetValue(null)!;
    }

    private static (string Prefix, string[] Methods, string Permission, bool Anonymous) Resolve(string path, string method)
    {
        return Matrix()
            .OrderByDescending(entry => entry.Prefix.Length)
            .First(entry =>
                path.StartsWith(entry.Prefix, System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                entry.Methods.Contains(method));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("/pages", "GET")]
    [InlineData("/pages", "POST")]
    [InlineData("/pages/shift-production", "PUT")]
    [InlineData("/pages/shift-production", "PATCH")]
    [InlineData("/pages/shift-production", "DELETE")]
    [InlineData("/pages/shift-production/publish", "POST")]
    [InlineData("/pages/shift-production/unpublish", "POST")]
    public void The_whole_page_route_family_resolves_to_page_design(string path, string method)
    {
        var entry = Resolve(path, method);

        Assert.Equal("/pages", entry.Prefix);
        Assert.Equal("page.design", entry.Permission);
        Assert.False(entry.Anonymous);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void One_entry_covers_the_family_rather_than_one_entry_per_verb()
    {
        var pageEntries = Matrix().Where(entry => entry.Prefix == "/pages").ToArray();

        Assert.Single(pageEntries);
        Assert.Equal(new[] { "GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE" }, pageEntries[0].Methods);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_page_read_no_longer_falls_through_the_anonymous_root_entry()
    {
        // This is the security half of the defect. Before the /pages entry
        // existed, this resolved to ("/", GET, anonymous) and served page
        // definitions without a token.
        var entry = Resolve("/pages", "GET");

        Assert.NotEqual("/", entry.Prefix);
        Assert.False(entry.Anonymous);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_authoring_permission_is_the_one_the_dashboard_definitions_use()
    {
        // Not a new permission, and not assistant.use: the same page.design the
        // sibling authoring route already carries.
        Assert.Equal(
            Resolve("/analytics/dashboard/definitions", "POST").Permission,
            Resolve("/pages", "POST").Permission);
    }
}
'@

    Line
    Say "REVERT $Rev"

function CountOf([string]$hay, [string]$needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($needle)) { return 0 }
    $n = 0
    $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle)
    while ($i -ge 0) { $n = $n + 1; $i = $hay.IndexOf($needle, $i + $needle.Length) }
    return $n
}

/// authoring flow tried to save.

/// These proofs read the matrix by reflection rather than by starting a host:
/// the question is what the table says, and a table is a better witness than a
/// round trip that could pass for an unrelated reason.
public sealed class PageBuilderRouteAccessControlTests
{
    private static (string Prefix, string[] Methods, string Permission, bool Anonymous)[] Matrix()
    {
        var type = typeof(PlantProcess.Api.Security.PlantAccessControl);
        var field = type.GetField("Matrix", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Static);

        Assert.NotNull(field);

        return ((string Prefix, string[] Methods, string Permission, bool Anonymous)[])field!.GetValue(null)!;
    }

    private static (string Prefix, string[] Methods, string Permission, bool Anonymous) Resolve(string path, string method)
    {
        return Matrix()
            .OrderByDescending(entry => entry.Prefix.Length)
            .First(entry =>
                path.StartsWith(entry.Prefix, System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                entry.Methods.Contains(method));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("/pages", "GET")]
    [InlineData("/pages", "POST")]
    [InlineData("/pages/shift-production", "PUT")]
    [InlineData("/pages/shift-production", "PATCH")]
    [InlineData("/pages/shift-production", "DELETE")]
    [InlineData("/pages/shift-production/publish", "POST")]
    [InlineData("/pages/shift-production/unpublish", "POST")]
    public void The_whole_page_route_family_resolves_to_page_design(string path, string method)
    {
        var entry = Resolve(path, method);

        Assert.Equal("/pages", entry.Prefix);
        Assert.Equal("page.design", entry.Permission);
        Assert.False(entry.Anonymous);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void One_entry_covers_the_family_rather_than_one_entry_per_verb()
    {
        var pageEntries = Matrix().Where(entry => entry.Prefix == "/pages").ToArray();

        Assert.Single(pageEntries);
        Assert.Equal(new[] { "GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE" }, pageEntries[0].Methods);
    }

<#
    PPIQ pack: apply-T-071-01-assistant-api-auth

    CONCERN (one only): src/api/assistantApi.ts carries its own fetch helper that
    sends cookies and nothing else. The application's access token lives in memory
    inside src/api/http/apiClient.ts and is attached only by that module's request
    builder. Both assistant endpoint groups require an authenticated principal:

        /api/assistant  -> MapGroup(...).RequireAuthorization()
        /api/phase8     -> MapGroup(...).RequireAuthorization()

    and Program.cs registers JwtBearer with no cookie-to-bearer bridge. So every
    call made through assistantApi is refused. T-071 did not create this; it made
    it visible on every authenticated page by moving the config call up into the
    layout.

    This pack attaches the token that the shared client already attaches, and
    changes nothing else. Base URL divergence and any retry policy are separate
    concerns and are deliberately not touched here.

    Contract: preflight -> report -> anchor verify with diagnosis -> backup ->
    apply -> on-disk self-check -> gate -> auto-revert on any failure.
    Report-only by default. Nothing is written without -Apply.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$Apply,
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$Revert
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$PackId       = "T-071-01-assistant-api-auth"

$Stamp        = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"

function Write-Line([string]$Text) { Write-Host $Text }
function Write-Head([string]$Text) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
    Write-Host $Text
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Get-FileText([string]$Path) {
    return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path)
}

function Set-FileText([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

function Get-NewlineConvention([string]$Text) {
    if ($Text.Contains("`r`n")) { return "CRLF" } else { return "LF" }
}

# Normalise a pack-authored fragment to the target file's own convention.
# Pack here-strings arrive with LF; the web sources are CRLF, so a multi-line
# anchor authored with LF never matches. This is applied to BOTH sides.
function ConvertTo-Convention([string]$Text, [string]$Convention) {
    $flat = $Text -replace "`r", ""
    if ($Convention -eq "CRLF") { return ($flat -replace "`n", "`r`n") }
    return $flat
}

function Get-NonAsciiCount([string]$Text) {
    $count = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) {
        if ([int]$ch -gt 127) { $count = $count + 1 }
    }
    return $count
}

# Every textual guard reads CODE, not prose: strip line comments and block
# comments before matching, so a guard can never match a comment this pack wrote.
function Get-CodeOnly([string]$Text) {
    $noBlock = [regex]::Replace($Text, "(?s)/\*.*?\*/", "")
    $lines = $noBlock -split "`n"
    $stripped = @()
    foreach ($line in $lines) { $stripped += ($line -replace "//.*$", "") }
    return ($stripped -join "`n")
}

function Get-Occurrences([string]$Text, [string]$Needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
    $count = 0
    $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    while ($index -ge 0) {
        $count = $count + 1
        $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, $index + $Needle.Length, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    }
    return $count
}

$Anchor1Text = @'
const apiBaseUrl = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL as string | undefined) ?? "http://localhost:5063";

$New1Text = @'
import { getAccessToken } from "@/api/http/apiClient";

const apiBaseUrl = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL as string | undefined) ?? "http://localhost:5063";
'@

$Anchor2Text = @'
async function api<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(apiBaseUrl + path, {
    credentials: "include",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...(init?.headers ?? {}),
    },
    ...init,
  });
'@

$New2Text = @'
async function api<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  /* PPIQ-T071 closure. This module had its own fetch helper that sent cookies
     only. The access token lives in memory in the shared client and is attached
     by that module alone, while both assistant endpoint groups require an
     authenticated principal and the host registers bearer validation with no
     cookie bridge. Every call from here was therefore refused. Attach the same
     token the shared client attaches; caller-supplied headers still win. */
  const accessToken = getAccessToken();
  const authHeaders: Record<string, string> = accessToken
    ? { Authorization: "Bearer " + accessToken }
    : {};

  const response = await fetch(apiBaseUrl + path, {
    credentials: "include",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...authHeaders,
      ...(init?.headers ?? {}),
    },
    ...init,
  });

$LineCount      = ($OriginalText -split "`n").Count

<#
    PPIQ pack: apply-T-071-02-dock-config-on-need

    CONCERN (one only): the dock provider asks for the assistant configuration
    exactly once, in a mount effect. The provider mounts with AppLayout, and on
    a hard refresh the layout can mount before the session token has been
    restored, so that single attempt can be refused and is never retried.

    Pack 01 fixed the missing credential on every assistant call. This pack
    fixes the single-shot timing: ask for the configuration when it is actually
    needed, and remember that it arrived. At mount, again on first expand of the
    dock, and again before the first question. A failed attempt leaves the flag
    clear so the next need retries.

    Deliberately NOT done here: no auth plumbing is read, no browser storage is
    introduced, no polling loop, no change to the single askAssistant call site.

    Contract: preflight -> report -> anchor verify with diagnosis -> backup ->
    apply -> on-disk self-check -> gate -> auto-revert on any failure.
    Report-only by default. Nothing is written without -Apply.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$Apply,
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$Revert
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$PackId       = "T-071-02-dock-config-on-need"
$RepoRootPath = (Get-Location).Path
$WebRootPath  = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Frontend\PlantProcess.Web"
$TargetPath   = Join-Path $WebRootPath "src\components\assistant\AssistantDockContext.tsx"
$Stamp        = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$BackupRoot   = Join-Path $RepoRootPath ("tools\packs\_backup_" + $PackId + "_" + $Stamp)

function Write-Line([string]$Text) { Write-Host $Text }
function Write-Head([string]$Text) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
    Write-Host $Text
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
}

function Get-FileText([string]$Path) {
    return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path)
}

function Set-FileText([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}

function Get-NewlineConvention([string]$Text) {
    if ($Text.Contains("`r`n")) { return "CRLF" } else { return "LF" }
}

function ConvertTo-Convention([string]$Text, [string]$Convention) {
    $flat = $Text -replace "`r", ""
    if ($Convention -eq "CRLF") { return ($flat -replace "`n", "`r`n") }
    return $flat
}

function Get-NonAsciiCount([string]$Text) {
    $count = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) {
        if ([int]$ch -gt 127) { $count = $count + 1 }
    }
    return $count
}

# Every textual guard reads CODE, not prose.
function Get-CodeOnly([string]$Text) {
    $noBlock = [regex]::Replace($Text, "(?s)/\*.*?\*/", "")
    $lines = $noBlock -split "`n"
    $stripped = @()
    foreach ($line in $lines) { $stripped += ($line -replace "//.*$", "") }
    return ($stripped -join "`n")
}

function Get-Occurrences([string]$Text, [string]$Needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
    $count = 0
    $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    while ($index -ge 0) {
        $count = $count + 1
        $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, $index + $Needle.Length, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    }
    return $count
}

# The three edits
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

$Anchor1Text = @'
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
'@

$New1Text = @'
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
'@

$Anchor2Text = @'
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    assistantApi
      .getAssistantConfig()
      .then((next) => {
        if (!active) return;
        setConfig(next);
        setStatus("Assistant runtime is configured.");
      })
      .catch((error: Error) => {
        if (!active) return;
        setStatus("Assistant configuration not reachable: " + error.message);
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, []);
'@

$New2Text = @'
  /* PPIQ-T071 closure. The provider mounts with the layout, which on a hard
     refresh can happen before the session token has been restored, so ONE
     attempt at mount is not enough: a refused first attempt was never retried
     and the panel kept the failure text for the rest of the session. Ask for
     the configuration when it is needed and remember that it arrived - at
     mount, again the first time the dock is expanded, and again before the
     first question. A refused attempt leaves the flag clear, so the next need
     retries. No storage, no polling, no auth plumbing is read here. */
  const configLoaded = useRef(false);
  const configInFlight = useRef(false);

  const ensureConfig = useCallback(async () => {
    if (configLoaded.current || configInFlight.current) return;
    configInFlight.current = true;
    setStatus("Loading assistant runtime configuration...");
    try {
      const next = await assistantApi.getAssistantConfig();
      configLoaded.current = true;
      setConfig(next);
      setStatus("Assistant runtime is configured.");
    } catch (error) {
      setStatus(
        "Assistant configuration not reachable: " +
          (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)),
      );
    } finally {
      configInFlight.current = false;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void ensureConfig();
  }, [ensureConfig]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (expanded) void ensureConfig();
  }, [expanded, ensureConfig]);
'@

$Anchor3Text = @'
      try {
        const result = await assistantApi.askAssistant(question, ASSISTANT_CONTEXT_CHIPS, config?.allowedTools ?? []);
'@

$New3Text = @'
      try {
        await ensureConfig();
        const result = await assistantApi.askAssistant(question, ASSISTANT_CONTEXT_CHIPS, config?.allowedTools ?? []);
'@

$Anchor4Text = @'
    [config],
  );
'@

$New4Text = @'
    [config, ensureConfig],
  );
'@

<#
    PPIQ pack: apply-T-071-03-auth-aware-config-guard

    CONCERN (one only): v2.9.2 adds an AUDIT HARDENING clause to T-071 - the
    dock's configuration path must be authentication-aware, and a fresh login
    must produce NO assistant-configuration 401 in the network log, before and
    after a hard reload. Packs 01 and 02 made that true. Nothing stops a later
    refactor from making it false again.

    This pack adds the ratchet. It touches ONE file, a test file, and asserts
    the three properties that together make the clause hold:

      1. the authenticated layout is not rendered while the session is still
         bootstrapping, so the provider cannot mount before the token exists
      2. the configuration request is made from the on-need path and not from
         an unconditional mount effect
      3. the assistant api client attaches the credential the protected
         endpoint groups require

    No production file is changed.

    Contract: preflight -> report -> anchor verify with diagnosis -> backup ->
    apply -> on-disk self-check -> gate -> auto-revert on any failure.
    Report-only by default. Nothing is written without -Apply.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$Apply,
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$Revert
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$PackId       = "T-071-03-auth-aware-config-guard"
$RepoRootPath = (Get-Location).Path
$WebRootPath  = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Frontend\PlantProcess.Web"
$TargetPath   = Join-Path $WebRootPath "src\test\architecture\assistantDock.test.ts"
$Stamp        = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$BackupRoot   = Join-Path $RepoRootPath ("tools\packs\_backup_" + $PackId + "_" + $Stamp)

function Write-Line([string]$Text) { Write-Host $Text }
function Write-Head([string]$Text) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
    Write-Host $Text
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
}

function Get-FileText([string]$Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }
function Set-FileText([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}
function Get-NewlineConvention([string]$Text) {
    if ($Text.Contains("`r`n")) { return "CRLF" } else { return "LF" }
}
function ConvertTo-Convention([string]$Text, [string]$Convention) {
    $flat = $Text -replace "`r", ""
    if ($Convention -eq "CRLF") { return ($flat -replace "`n", "`r`n") }
    return $flat
}
function Get-NonAsciiCount([string]$Text) {
    $count = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 127) { $count = $count + 1 } }
    return $count
}
function Get-CodeOnly([string]$Text) {
    $noBlock = [regex]::Replace($Text, "(?s)/\*.*?\*/", "")
    $lines = $noBlock -split "`n"
    $stripped = @()
    foreach ($line in $lines) { $stripped += ($line -replace "//.*$", "") }
    return ($stripped -join "`n")
}
function Get-Occurrences([string]$Text, [string]$Needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
    $count = 0
    $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    while ($index -ge 0) {
        $count = $count + 1
        $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, $index + $Needle.Length, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    }
    return $count
}

# The edit: one new test block appended inside the existing describe
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

$AnchorText = @'
  it("no test-only mutation hatch was added to production code", () => {
    const ctx = read("src/components/assistant/AssistantDockContext.tsx");
    expect(ctx).not.toContain("setTurns:");
    expect(ctx).not.toContain("__test");
  });
});
'@

$NewText = @'
  it("no test-only mutation hatch was added to production code", () => {
    const ctx = read("src/components/assistant/AssistantDockContext.tsx");
    expect(ctx).not.toContain("setTurns:");
    expect(ctx).not.toContain("__test");
  });

  /* PPIQ-T071 audit hardening, v2.9.2. A fresh login must produce no
     assistant-configuration refusal in the network log, before and after a
     hard reload. Three source properties make that true together, and each
     one is asserted here so a later refactor cannot quietly undo it. */

  it("the authenticated layout is not rendered while the session is bootstrapping", () => {
    const app = read("src/App.tsx");
    const gate = app.indexOf("if (isBootstrapping || bootstrapError)");
    const layout = app.indexOf("element={<AppLayout />}");
    expect(gate).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    expect(layout).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    /* The gate returns before the layout route exists, so the provider that
       AppLayout mounts cannot run before the session has been restored. */
    expect(gate).toBeLessThan(layout);
  });

  it("the configuration is requested from the on-need path, not an unconditional mount effect", () => {
    const ctx = read("src/components/assistant/AssistantDockContext.tsx");
    expect(ctx).toContain("const ensureConfig = useCallback");
    const guard = ctx.indexOf("configLoaded.current");
    const call = ctx.indexOf(".getAssistantConfig()");
    expect(guard).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    expect(call).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    /* The arrival guard is read before the request is made, and the request
       exists in exactly one place. */
    expect(guard).toBeLessThan(call);
    expect(ctx.split(".getAssistantConfig()").length - 1).toBe(1);
  });

  it("the assistant api client sends the credential the protected groups require", () => {
    const client = read("src/api/assistantApi.ts");
    expect(client).toContain('from "@/api/http/apiClient"');
    expect(client).toContain("getAccessToken()");
    const attached = client.indexOf("authHeaders");
    const caller = client.indexOf("...(init?.headers ?? {}),");
    expect(attached).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    expect(caller).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    /* Caller-supplied headers are still spread last, so they win. */
    expect(attached).toBeLessThan(caller);
  });
});
'@

if ($PreFailures.Count -gt 0) {

<#
    PPIQ pack: apply-T-071-04-no-standalone-assistant-route

    T-071 visible-contract correction, ruled by the tech-lead review.

    One concern: the G1 contract is "global shell component, no route". The code
    still carries a full-page assistant concept - a customer-reachable
    /assistant route rendering AssistantRuntimePage, a nav entry pointing at it,
    and a dock that special-cases itself off on that route. The existing "not a
    route element" assertion only proved AssistantDock was not placed in a
    Route; it never proved the standalone runtime page had gone.

    Measured before writing, from source:
      - App.tsx line ~691 routes /assistant to AssistantRuntimePage through
        withPageBoundary, and line ~698 redirects /phase8/assistant to it.
      - AppLayout declares NAV_ASSISTANT with an /assistant entry. NOTE: that
        array is DECLARED AND NEVER RENDERED - the sidebar renders only
        NAV_DATA_INTEGRATION, NAV_ANALYTICS, NAV_INTELLIGENCE and NAV_SYSTEM.
        So the entry is already invisible; it is removed here so it cannot come
        back, not because it is currently on screen.
      - noPhaseTokensOnDemoPath asserts App.tsx still contains path="/assistant",
        and assistantChain asserts roleAccess still maps "/assistant". A hidden
        compatibility redirect keeps BOTH green, which is why the route is
        retained as a redirect rather than deleted outright. That is the
        measured dependency the review allowed for.
      - Sparkles is also used by the /brand entry, so removing the assistant nav
        line leaves no unused import.

    So: the page is retired, the route becomes a hidden redirect to /dashboard,
    the dock stops suppressing itself, and the guards are strengthened so a
    standalone assistant route or nav entry fails the suite.

    Two architecture assertions that PINNED THE OLD ARCHITECTURE are rewritten
    rather than deleted, on the T-069 precedent: a test that pins the wrong
    architecture is worse than no test. The rule each one protects is kept.

    NOT DONE HERE, and reported rather than silently broken: three Playwright
    specs and the J15 entry of the journey audit still name /assistant. The
    audit entry is repointed at the dock in this pack because the assistant
    surface is ours. The e2e specs belong to the certification track and run in
    no gate today, so they are left for that owner.

    Contract: preflight -> report -> anchor verify with diagnosis -> backup ->
    apply -> on-disk self-check -> gate -> auto-revert on any failure.
    Report-only by default. Nothing is written without -Apply.
#>

<#
    PPIQ pack: apply-T-072-01-context-envelope-backend

    T-072, backend half. One concern: the ask request carries a typed page and
    widget context envelope, that envelope NARROWS retrieval, and it can never
    become answer evidence.

    Measured before writing, from source:
      - AskRequest already accepts ContextChips and AssistantRequest already
        carries them into AssistantService. AskAsync then builds
        new RetrievalQuery(TenantId, Role, Question) and NEVER READS THEM.
        The transport exists; the narrowing step is what is missing.
      - The client sends ["grounded", "approved findings"], which are labels,
        not page context.
      - NpgsqlRetrievalIndex ranks by cosine over the embedding of query.Text,
        so the honest narrowing point in THIS index is the embedded text.
      - _model.Draft(request, ...) receives the whole request, which is the one
        path by which a context value could be echoed into an answer.

    What this pack does:
      1. AssistantContextEnvelope, a typed record: route, page code, widget
         code, selections, filters, last-result summary, evidence handles.
      2. Only the IDENTIFIERS contribute retrieval terms. The last-result
         summary and the evidence handles are carried for the surfaces that
         link back to evidence and are deliberately NOT embedded, because a
         number supplied by the client must not influence what the retrieval
         layer treats as evidence. Terms are trimmed and capped so a client
         cannot stuff the embedded text.
      3. The model is handed the request with the envelope STRIPPED, so echoing
         a context value is structurally impossible rather than forbidden by a
         string check. Tenant, role and license stay claim-derived: the
         envelope narrows and never widens permission (Chapter 4 5.7.2).
      4. Six unit tests, including the two-pages case and the no-echo case.

    Frontend half is a separate pack.

    Contract: preflight -> report -> anchor verify with diagnosis -> backup ->
    apply -> on-disk self-check -> gate -> auto-revert on any failure.
    Report-only by default. Nothing is written without -Apply.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$Apply,
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$Revert
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$PackId       = "T-072-01-context-envelope-backend"
$RepoRootPath = (Get-Location).Path
$Stamp        = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$BackupRoot   = Join-Path $RepoRootPath ("tools\packs\_backup_" + $PackId + "_" + $Stamp)

$ContractsPath = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\PlantProcess.Application\Assistant\AssistantContracts.cs"
$ServicePath   = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\PlantProcess.Application\Assistant\AssistantService.cs"
$IndexPath     = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure\Assistant\NpgsqlRetrievalIndex.cs"
$EndpointsPath = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\PlantProcess.Api\Endpoints\Assistant\AssistantEndpoints.cs"
$TestPath      = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Application.UnitTests\Assistant\T072ContextEnvelopeTests.cs"

function Write-Line([string]$Text) { Write-Host $Text }
function Write-Head([string]$Text) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
    Write-Host $Text
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
}

function Get-FileText([string]$Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }
function Set-FileText([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}
function Get-NewlineConvention([string]$Text) {
    if ($Text.Contains("`r`n")) { return "CRLF" } else { return "LF" }
}
function ConvertTo-Convention([string]$Text, [string]$Convention) {
    $flat = $Text -replace "`r", ""
    if ($Convention -eq "CRLF") { return ($flat -replace "`n", "`r`n") }
    return $flat
}
function Get-NonAsciiCount([string]$Text) {
    $count = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 127) { $count = $count + 1 } }
    return $count
}
function Get-CodeOnly([string]$Text) {
    $noBlock = [regex]::Replace($Text, "(?s)/\*.*?\*/", "")
    $lines = $noBlock -split "`n"
    $stripped = @()
    foreach ($line in $lines) { $stripped += ($line -replace "//.*$", "") }
    return ($stripped -join "`n")
}
function Get-Occurrences([string]$Text, [string]$Needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
    $count = 0
    $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    while ($index -ge 0) {
        $count = $count + 1
        $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, $index + $Needle.Length, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    }
    return $count
}
