# Edits
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

$ContractsAnchor1 = @'
public sealed record RetrievalQuery(Guid TenantId, string Role, string Text, int TopK = 6);
'@

$ContractsNew1 = @'
public sealed record RetrievalQuery(
    Guid TenantId, string Role, string Text, int TopK = 6, IReadOnlyList<string>? ContextTerms = null);
'@

$ContractsAnchor2 = @'
public sealed record AssistantRequest(
    Guid TenantId, string Role, string License, string Question, IReadOnlyList<string> ContextChips);
'@

$ContractsNew2 = @'
/// <summary>
/// T-072. What the user is looking at when the question is asked.
///
/// The law this record exists to keep: CONTEXT NARROWS RETRIEVAL, AND CONTEXT IS
/// NOT EVIDENCE. Only the identifiers below contribute retrieval terms. The
/// last-result summary and the evidence handles are carried so the evidence
/// surfaces can link back, and are deliberately NOT embedded, because a number
/// supplied by the client must never influence what the retrieval layer treats
/// as evidence. Tenant, role and licence are NOT here: they come from the
/// caller's claims, so this envelope can narrow a search and can never widen
/// permission.
/// </summary>
public sealed record AssistantContextEnvelope(
    string? Route = null,
    string? PageCode = null,
    string? WidgetCode = null,
    IReadOnlyList<string>? Selections = null,
    IReadOnlyList<string>? Filters = null,
    string? LastResultSummary = null,
    IReadOnlyList<string>? EvidenceHandles = null)
{
    private const int MaxTermLength = 120;
    private const int MaxTerms = 24;

    /// <summary>The terms this envelope contributes to retrieval, and nothing else.</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<string> RetrievalTerms()
    {
        var terms = new List<string>();

        void Add(string? value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return;
            if (terms.Count >= MaxTerms) return;
            var trimmed = value.Trim();
            if (trimmed.Length > MaxTermLength) trimmed = trimmed.Substring(0, MaxTermLength);
            terms.Add(trimmed);
        }

        Add(Route);
        Add(PageCode);
        Add(WidgetCode);
        foreach (var selection in Selections ?? Array.Empty<string>()) Add(selection);
        foreach (var filter in Filters ?? Array.Empty<string>()) Add(filter);

        return terms;
    }
}

public sealed record AssistantRequest(
    Guid TenantId, string Role, string License, string Question, IReadOnlyList<string> ContextChips,
    AssistantContextEnvelope? Context = null);
'@

$ServiceAnchor1 = @'
        var chunks = await _retrieval.SearchAsync(new RetrievalQuery(request.TenantId, request.Role, request.Question), ct);
'@

$ServiceNew1 = @'
        // T-072: the envelope narrows the search and nothing else. Tenant and role
        // still come from the caller's claims, so context can never widen scope.
        var contextTerms = request.Context?.RetrievalTerms() ?? Array.Empty<string>();

        var chunks = await _retrieval.SearchAsync(
            new RetrievalQuery(request.TenantId, request.Role, request.Question, 6, contextTerms), ct);
'@

$ServiceAnchor2 = @'
        var draft = _model.Draft(request, chunks, toolResults);
'@

$ServiceNew2 = @'
        // T-072: the model is handed the request WITHOUT the envelope. Echoing a
        // context value into an answer is then structurally impossible rather than
        // forbidden by a string check, for this model and for any model swapped in
        // later. Retrieval has already used it by this point.
        var draft = _model.Draft(request with { Context = null }, chunks, toolResults);
'@

$IndexAnchor = @'
        var q = _embedder.Embed(query.Text).ToArray();
'@

$IndexNew = @'
        // T-072: this index ranks by cosine over the embedded question, so the
        // honest narrowing point here is the embedded text. The caller has already
        // decided which context terms are allowed to reach it.
        var embedText = query.ContextTerms is { Count: > 0 }
            ? query.Text + " " + string.Join(" ", query.ContextTerms)
            : query.Text;

        var q = _embedder.Embed(embedText).ToArray();
'@

$EndpointsAnchor1 = @'
    public sealed record AskRequest(string Question, IReadOnlyList<string>? ContextChips, IReadOnlyList<ToolCallDto>? Tools);
'@

$EndpointsNew1 = @'
    public sealed record AskRequest(
        string Question,
        IReadOnlyList<string>? ContextChips,
        IReadOnlyList<ToolCallDto>? Tools,
        ContextEnvelopeDto? Context = null);

    /// <summary>T-072 wire shape of the page and widget context envelope.</summary>
    public sealed record ContextEnvelopeDto(
        string? Route = null,
        string? PageCode = null,
        string? WidgetCode = null,
        IReadOnlyList<string>? Selections = null,
        IReadOnlyList<string>? Filters = null,
        string? LastResultSummary = null,
        IReadOnlyList<string>? EvidenceHandles = null);
'@

$EndpointsAnchor2 = @'
            var request = new AssistantRequest(
                tenantId, Role(user), License(user), req.Question ?? string.Empty,
                req.ContextChips ?? Array.Empty<string>());
'@

$EndpointsNew2 = @'
            var envelope = req.Context is null ? null : new AssistantContextEnvelope(
                req.Context.Route,
                req.Context.PageCode,
                req.Context.WidgetCode,
                req.Context.Selections,
                req.Context.Filters,
                req.Context.LastResultSummary,
                req.Context.EvidenceHandles);

            var request = new AssistantRequest(
                tenantId, Role(user), License(user), req.Question ?? string.Empty,
                req.ContextChips ?? Array.Empty<string>(), envelope);

/// <summary>
/// T-072. The context envelope must reach the retrieval call, must change what is
/// retrieved between two pages, and must never reach the answer composer.
/// </summary>
public class T072ContextEnvelopeTests
{
    private sealed class CapturingIndex : IRetrievalIndex
    {
        public RetrievalQuery? LastQuery;
        public readonly List<RetrievedChunk> Chunks = new();

        public Task<IReadOnlyList<RetrievedChunk>> SearchAsync(RetrievalQuery query, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            LastQuery = query;
            return Task.FromResult((IReadOnlyList<RetrievedChunk>)Chunks);
        }

        public Task<ReindexResult> ReindexAsync(ReindexRequest request, CancellationToken ct)
            => Task.FromResult(new ReindexResult(0, 0, request.CorrelationId));
    }

    private sealed class CapturingModel : IAssistantModel
    {
        public AssistantRequest? LastRequest;

        public AssistantDraft Draft(AssistantRequest request, IReadOnlyList<RetrievedChunk> chunks, IReadOnlyList<ToolResult> tools)
        {
            LastRequest = request;
            var text = string.Join(" ", chunks.Select(c => c.Content));
            var claims = chunks
                .Select(c => new AssistantClaim(c.Content, c.Handle, Array.Empty<string>()))
                .ToList();
            return new AssistantDraft(text, claims);
        }
    }

    private static (AssistantService Service, CapturingIndex Index, CapturingModel Model) Build()
    {
        var index = new CapturingIndex();
        index.Chunks.Add(new RetrievedChunk(
            Guid.NewGuid(), "finding", "f-1",
            "Defect rate is elevated on the finishing line.",
            ProvenanceHandle.Finding("f-1"), 1.0));

        var model = new CapturingModel();
        var service = new AssistantService(index, new ToolRegistry(Array.Empty<ITool>()), model);
        return (service, index, model);
    }

    private static AssistantRequest Ask(string question, AssistantContextEnvelope? context)
        => new(Guid.NewGuid(), "engineer", "pro-plus", question, Array.Empty<string>(), context);

    [Fact]
    public async Task The_envelope_identifiers_reach_the_retrieval_call()
    {
        var (service, index, _) = Build();

        await service.AskAsync(
            Ask("what does this chart show", new AssistantContextEnvelope(
                Route: "/dashboard/quality",
                PageCode: "PAGE_ALPHA",
                WidgetCode: "WIDGET_ALPHA",
                Selections: new[] { "SELECTION_ALPHA" },
                Filters: new[] { "FILTER_ALPHA" })),
            null, CancellationToken.None);

        var terms = index.LastQuery!.ContextTerms!;
        Assert.Contains("/dashboard/quality", terms);
        Assert.Contains("PAGE_ALPHA", terms);
        Assert.Contains("WIDGET_ALPHA", terms);
        Assert.Contains("SELECTION_ALPHA", terms);
        Assert.Contains("FILTER_ALPHA", terms);
        Assert.Equal("what does this chart show", index.LastQuery.Text);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task The_same_question_on_two_pages_retrieves_under_different_context()
    {
        var (service, index, _) = Build();

        await service.AskAsync(
            Ask("what does this chart show", new AssistantContextEnvelope(PageCode: "PAGE_ALPHA", WidgetCode: "WIDGET_ALPHA")),
            null, CancellationToken.None);
        var first = index.LastQuery!.ContextTerms!.ToArray();

        await service.AskAsync(
            Ask("what does this chart show", new AssistantContextEnvelope(PageCode: "PAGE_BETA", WidgetCode: "WIDGET_BETA")),
            null, CancellationToken.None);
        var second = index.LastQuery!.ContextTerms!.ToArray();

        Assert.NotEqual(first, second);
        Assert.Contains("PAGE_ALPHA", first);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("PAGE_ALPHA", second);
    }

    [Fact]

<#
    PPIQ pack: apply-T-072-02-context-envelope-frontend

    T-072, frontend half. One concern: the dock sends what the user is actually
    looking at, so the envelope the backend already accepts stops being empty.

    Measured before writing, from source:
      - AppRoutes wraps <Routes> in DashboardFilterProvider,
        DashboardSelectionProvider and DashboardGridLayoutProvider, and the
        AppLayout route sits inside all three. So the dock can read the live
        filters and selections WITHOUT touching a single page or widget file -
        Worker 2's surfaces are not modified by this pack.
      - useDashboardSelection() exposes selections carrying field, value, label
        and sourceWidget. sourceWidget is a real focused-widget signal that
        already exists; nothing new has to be invented for it.
      - useDashboardFilters() exposes the live filters record.
      - The provider's ask() is the single call site, so the envelope is passed
        INTO ask rather than assembled inside the provider. That keeps the
        provider free of dashboard hooks, which is what stops the T-071
        persistence test - which mounts the provider with no dashboard
        providers around it - from breaking.

    Deliberately empty for now, and this is a recorded decision, not an
    oversight: lastResultSummary and evidenceHandles. Filling them means
    reading a widget's executed result, which is T-073's job and would mean
    editing Worker 2's widgets today. The shape is on the wire and ready.

    pageCode is the FIRST path segment, not the last: on /materials/:id the last
    segment is a row identifier, not a page. The full route travels separately,
    so nothing is lost. When Worker 2's page definitions expose a definitive
    code, one line changes.

    Contract: preflight -> report -> anchor verify with diagnosis -> backup ->
    apply -> on-disk self-check -> gate -> auto-revert on any failure.
    Report-only by default. Nothing is written without -Apply.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$Apply,
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$Revert
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$PackId       = "T-072-02-context-envelope-frontend"
$RepoRootPath = (Get-Location).Path

function Write-Line([string]$Text) { Write-Host $Text }
function Write-Head([string]$Text) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
    Write-Host $Text
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
}

function Get-FileText([string]$Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }
function Set-FileText([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}
function Get-NewlineConvention([string]$Text) {
    if ($Text.Contains("`r`n")) { return "CRLF" } else { return "LF" }
}
function ConvertTo-Convention([string]$Text, [string]$Convention) {
    $flat = $Text -replace "`r", ""
    if ($Convention -eq "CRLF") { return ($flat -replace "`n", "`r`n") }
    return $flat
}
function Get-NonAsciiCount([string]$Text) {
    $count = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 127) { $count = $count + 1 } }
    return $count
}
function Get-CodeOnly([string]$Text) {
    $noBlock = [regex]::Replace($Text, "(?s)/\*.*?\*/", "")
    $lines = $noBlock -split "`n"
    $stripped = @()
    foreach ($line in $lines) { $stripped += ($line -replace "//.*$", "") }
    return ($stripped -join "`n")
}
function Get-Occurrences([string]$Text, [string]$Needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
    $count = 0
    $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    while ($index -ge 0) {
        $count = $count + 1
        $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, $index + $Needle.Length, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    }
    return $count
}

$HookFileText = @'
/* PPIQ-T072 */
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import type { AssistantContextPayload } from "@/api/assistantApi";
import { useDashboardFilters } from "@/state/DashboardFilterContext";
import { useDashboardSelection } from "@/state/DashboardSelectionContext";

/**
 * What the user is looking at, assembled from state the application already
 * keeps. Nothing here is invented and no page or widget file is modified to
 * produce it: the route comes from the router, the selections and filters come
 * from the dashboard providers that already wrap every authenticated route.
 *
 * The server treats this as a way to NARROW retrieval and never as evidence, so
 * being approximate is safe and being wrong is not dangerous - it can only make
 * a search less relevant, never make an answer less true.
 */

/** Pagination and ordering keys. Technical, not vocabulary - they say nothing
 *  about what the user is looking at, so they are left out of the envelope. */
const NON_CONTEXT_KEYS = [
  "page",
  "pageSize",
  "skip",
  "take",
  "offset",
  "limit",
  "sort",
  "sortBy",
  "sortDirection",
];

export interface AssistantSelectionLike {
  field: string | number | symbol;
  value: string | number;
  label?: string;
  sourceWidget?: string;
}

export interface AssistantContextInput {
  pathname: string;
  selections?: readonly AssistantSelectionLike[];
  filters?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
}

/**
 * Pure, so it can be tested without a router or a provider.
 *
 * pageCode is the FIRST path segment rather than the last, because on a detail
 * route the last segment is a row identifier and not a page. The full route
 * travels beside it, so no information is lost by that choice.
 */
export function buildAssistantContext(input: AssistantContextInput): AssistantContextPayload {
  const segments = (input.pathname ?? "").split("/").filter((segment) => segment.length > 0);
  const selections = input.selections ?? [];

  const selectionTerms = selections
    .filter((selection) => selection.value !== undefined && selection.value !== null)
    .map((selection) => String(selection.field) + ":" + String(selection.value));

  const focused = [...selections].reverse().find((selection) => Boolean(selection.sourceWidget));

  const filterTerms = Object.entries(input.filters ?? {})
    .filter(([key, value]) =>
      !NON_CONTEXT_KEYS.includes(key) &&
      value !== undefined &&
      value !== null &&
      String(value).length > 0)
    .map(([key, value]) => key + ":" + String(value));

  return {
    route: input.pathname && input.pathname.length > 0 ? input.pathname : null,
    pageCode: segments.length > 0 ? segments[0] : null,
    widgetCode: focused?.sourceWidget ?? null,
    selections: selectionTerms,
    filters: filterTerms,
    /* T-073 fills these from a real widget result. Empty is the honest value
       until then: an invented summary would be exactly the fabrication the
       grounding contract exists to prevent. */
    lastResultSummary: null,
    evidenceHandles: null,
  };
}

/**
 * Safe to call only inside the dashboard providers. AppRoutes wraps every
 * authenticated route in them and AppLayout renders inside that, so the dock
 * always satisfies this. An architecture assertion holds that arrangement.
 */
export function useAssistantPageContext(): AssistantContextPayload {
  const location = useLocation();
  const { filters } = useDashboardFilters();
  const { selections } = useDashboardSelection();

  return useMemo(
    () =>
      buildAssistantContext({
        pathname: location.pathname,
        selections: selections as unknown as readonly AssistantSelectionLike[],
        filters: filters as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
      }),
    [location.pathname, selections, filters],
  );
}

$TestFileText = @'
// @vitest-environment node
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { buildAssistantContext } from "../assistantPageContext";

/* PPIQ-T072 frontend half.
 *
 * The envelope must describe the surface without inventing anything, and the
 * wiring that carries it must stay in place. Both are asserted here.
 */

const webRoot = resolve(__dirname, "..", "..", "..", "..");
const read = (rel: string) => (existsSync(resolve(webRoot, rel)) ? readFileSync(resolve(webRoot, rel), "utf8") : "");

describe("T-072 the envelope describes the surface", () => {
  it("takes the page code from the first segment, not a row identifier", () => {
    const detail = buildAssistantContext({ pathname: "/materials/8f14e45f-ceea-467a-9f6a-1b2c3d4e5f60" });
    expect(detail.pageCode).toBe("materials");
    expect(detail.route).toBe("/materials/8f14e45f-ceea-467a-9f6a-1b2c3d4e5f60");
  });

  it("carries selections and names the widget the last one came from", () => {
    const context = buildAssistantContext({
      pathname: "/dashboard",
      selections: [
        { field: "siteId", value: "SITE_ALPHA", sourceWidget: "WIDGET_ALPHA" },
        { field: "equipmentId", value: "EQUIP_BETA", sourceWidget: "WIDGET_BETA" },
      ],
    });

    expect(context.selections).toEqual(["siteId:SITE_ALPHA", "equipmentId:EQUIP_BETA"]);
    expect(context.widgetCode).toBe("WIDGET_BETA");
  });

  it("drops pagination and ordering keys and keeps the real filters", () => {
    const context = buildAssistantContext({
      pathname: "/dashboard",
      filters: { siteId: "SITE_ALPHA", page: 2, pageSize: 50, sortBy: "createdAt", areaId: "" },
    });

    expect(context.filters).toEqual(["siteId:SITE_ALPHA"]);
  });

  it("never invents a result summary or an evidence handle", () => {
    const context = buildAssistantContext({ pathname: "/dashboard" });
    expect(context.lastResultSummary).toBeNull();
    expect(context.evidenceHandles).toBeNull();
  });

  it("survives an empty surface", () => {
    const context = buildAssistantContext({ pathname: "" });
    expect(context.route).toBeNull();
    expect(context.pageCode).toBeNull();
    expect(context.selections).toEqual([]);
    expect(context.filters).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("T-072 the wiring that carries the envelope", () => {
  it("the dashboard providers wrap the authenticated layout", () => {
    const app = read("src/App.tsx");
    const filterProvider = app.indexOf("<DashboardFilterProvider>");
    const selectionProvider = app.indexOf("<DashboardSelectionProvider>");
    const layout = app.indexOf("element={<AppLayout />}");

    expect(filterProvider).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    expect(selectionProvider).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    expect(layout).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    /* The dock reads those providers, so the layout must stay inside them. */
    expect(filterProvider).toBeLessThan(layout);
    expect(selectionProvider).toBeLessThan(layout);
  });

  it("the dock passes the surface into ask and the provider forwards it", () => {
    const dock = read("src/components/assistant/AssistantDock.tsx");
    expect(dock).toContain("useAssistantPageContext()");
    expect(dock).toContain("ask(question, pageContext)");

    const provider = read("src/components/assistant/AssistantDockContext.tsx");
    expect(provider).toContain("context?: AssistantContextPayload | null");
    expect(provider).toContain("context ?? null,");
  });

  it("the provider still holds no dashboard hook, so it mounts anywhere", () => {
    const provider = read("src/components/assistant/AssistantDockContext.tsx");
    expect(provider).not.toContain("useDashboardFilters");
    expect(provider).not.toContain("useDashboardSelection");
  });

  it("the request body carries the envelope", () => {
    const client = read("src/api/assistantApi.ts");
    expect(client).toContain("export type AssistantContextPayload");
    expect(client).toContain("context: context ?? null,");
  });
});

function Restore-All {
    Set-FileText $ApiPath      $ApiText
    Set-FileText $ProviderPath $ProviderText
    Set-FileText $DockPath     $DockText
    foreach ($added in @($HookPath, $TestPath)) {
        if (Test-Path $added) { Remove-Item $added -Force }
    }
}

if ($Failures.Count -gt 0) {

    Write-Line ""
    Restore-All
    Write-Line "OK    reverted; backup remains at $BackupRoot"
    exit 1
}

Write-Line "OK    provider forwards it and still holds no dashboard hook"

Write-Line "OK    result summary and evidence handles stay empty until T-073"
Write-Line "OK    T-071 credential and on-need configuration both intact"
Write-Line "OK    nine tests present, no non-ASCII in any touched file"

    Write-Line "FAIL  node_modules\typescript\bin\tsc not found - run npm ci in Frontend\PlantProcess.Web"

    Write-Line "OK    reverted"
    exit 1
}

& node $TscPath -b
$TscExit = $LASTEXITCODE
Pop-Location

if ($TscExit -ne 0) {
    Write-Line "FAIL  tsc -b exited $TscExit"

Write-Line "OK    tsc -b clean"

exit 0

<#
    PPIQ pack: apply-T-072-03-prefixed-retrieval-hints

    T-072 correction, ruled by the tech-lead review.

    One concern: the retrieval hints must carry normalised selection and filter
    VALUES in a form that says what kind of hint each one is, not bare
    identifiers. The ruled shape:

        page:QUALITY
        widget:DEFECT_BY_EQUIPMENT
        selection:grade=DX51D
        filter:equipment=CCM-01

    Why the current shape is wrong, stated plainly: a selection on siteId and a
    filter on siteId both emitted "siteId:SITE_ALPHA", so two different kinds of
    hint produced the identical token and the page and widget codes arrived bare
    and indistinguishable from either. Ranking cannot use what it cannot tell
    apart.

    Where each half of the change lives, and why:
      - The FRONTEND joins field and value with "=" because that is where the
        two are still separate and typed. String surgery on the server to split
        them back out would be fragile.
      - The BACKEND applies the "selection:" and "filter:" prefixes, because it
        is the side that knows which list a term came from.

    Unchanged, deliberately: these remain HINTS. They influence ranking and
    nothing else. The composer still receives request with Context = null, so no
    hint can become an answer claim, and tenant, role and licence remain
    claim-derived.

    Contract: preflight -> report -> anchor verify with diagnosis -> backup ->
    apply -> on-disk self-check -> gate -> auto-revert on any failure.
    Report-only by default. Nothing is written without -Apply.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$Apply,
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$Revert
)

function Write-Line([string]$Text) { Write-Host $Text }
function Write-Head([string]$Text) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
    Write-Host $Text
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
}

function Get-FileText([string]$Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }
function Set-FileText([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}
function Get-NewlineConvention([string]$Text) {
    if ($Text.Contains("`r`n")) { return "CRLF" } else { return "LF" }
}
function ConvertTo-Convention([string]$Text, [string]$Convention) {
    $flat = $Text -replace "`r", ""
    if ($Convention -eq "CRLF") { return ($flat -replace "`n", "`r`n") }
    return $flat
}
function Get-NonAsciiCount([string]$Text) {
    $count = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 127) { $count = $count + 1 } }
    return $count
}
function Get-CodeOnly([string]$Text) {
    $noBlock = [regex]::Replace($Text, "(?s)/\*.*?\*/", "")
    $lines = $noBlock -split "`n"
    $stripped = @()
    foreach ($line in $lines) { $stripped += ($line -replace "//.*$", "") }
    return ($stripped -join "`n")
}
function Get-Occurrences([string]$Text, [string]$Needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
    $count = 0
    $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    while ($index -ge 0) {
        $count = $count + 1
        $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, $index + $Needle.Length, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    }
    return $count
}

$ContractsAnchor = @'
        void Add(string? value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return;
            if (terms.Count >= MaxTerms) return;
            var trimmed = value.Trim();
            if (trimmed.Length > MaxTermLength) trimmed = trimmed.Substring(0, MaxTermLength);
            terms.Add(trimmed);
        }

        Add(Route);
        Add(PageCode);
        Add(WidgetCode);
        foreach (var selection in Selections ?? Array.Empty<string>()) Add(selection);
        foreach (var filter in Filters ?? Array.Empty<string>()) Add(filter);

        return terms;
'@

$ContractsNew = @'
        // Every term is PREFIXED with the kind of hint it is, so ranking can tell
        // a page from a widget and a selection from a filter on the same field.
        // The client sends selections and filters already joined as field=value,
        // because that is the side where the two are still separate and typed.
        void Add(string kind, string? value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return;
            if (terms.Count >= MaxTerms) return;
            var trimmed = value.Trim();
            if (trimmed.Length > MaxTermLength) trimmed = trimmed.Substring(0, MaxTermLength);
            terms.Add(kind + ":" + trimmed);
        }

        Add("route", Route);
        Add("page", PageCode);
        Add("widget", WidgetCode);
        foreach (var selection in Selections ?? Array.Empty<string>()) Add("selection", selection);
        foreach (var filter in Filters ?? Array.Empty<string>()) Add("filter", filter);

        return terms;
'@

        var terms = new AssistantContextEnvelope(PageCode: "PAGE_ALPHA", Selections: selections).RetrievalTerms();

        Assert.True(terms.Count <= 24);
        /* The cap applies to the VALUE; the kind prefix is added after it, so the
           term is the value cap plus a short prefix and never unbounded. */

    [Fact]

<#
    PPIQ pack: apply-T-072-03-prefixed-retrieval-hints

    T-072 correction, ruled by the tech-lead review.

    One concern: the retrieval hints must carry normalised selection and filter
    VALUES in a form that says what kind of hint each one is, not bare
    identifiers. The ruled shape:

        page:QUALITY
        widget:DEFECT_BY_EQUIPMENT
        selection:grade=DX51D
        filter:equipment=CCM-01

    Why the current shape is wrong, stated plainly: a selection on siteId and a
    filter on siteId both emitted "siteId:SITE_ALPHA", so two different kinds of
    hint produced the identical token and the page and widget codes arrived bare
    and indistinguishable from either. Ranking cannot use what it cannot tell
    apart.

    Where each half of the change lives, and why:
      - The FRONTEND joins field and value with "=" because that is where the
        two are still separate and typed. String surgery on the server to split
        them back out would be fragile.
      - The BACKEND applies the "selection:" and "filter:" prefixes, because it
        is the side that knows which list a term came from.

    Unchanged, deliberately: these remain HINTS. They influence ranking and
    nothing else. The composer still receives request with Context = null, so no
    hint can become an answer claim, and tenant, role and licence remain
    claim-derived.

    Contract: preflight -> report -> anchor verify with diagnosis -> backup ->
    apply -> on-disk self-check -> gate -> auto-revert on any failure.
    Report-only by default. Nothing is written without -Apply.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]

    [switch]$Apply,
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$Revert

$ContractsPath = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\PlantProcess.Application\Assistant\AssistantContracts.cs"
$BackTestPath  = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Application.UnitTests\Assistant\T072ContextEnvelopeTests.cs"

$FrontTestPath = Join-Path $WebRootPath "src\components\assistant\__tests__\assistantContextEnvelope.test.ts"

function Write-Line([string]$Text) { Write-Host $Text }
function Write-Head([string]$Text) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
    Write-Host $Text
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
}

function Get-FileText([string]$Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }
function Set-FileText([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}
function Get-NewlineConvention([string]$Text) {
    if ($Text.Contains("`r`n")) { return "CRLF" } else { return "LF" }
}
function ConvertTo-Convention([string]$Text, [string]$Convention) {
    $flat = $Text -replace "`r", ""
    if ($Convention -eq "CRLF") { return ($flat -replace "`n", "`r`n") }
    return $flat
}
function Get-NonAsciiCount([string]$Text) {
    $count = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 127) { $count = $count + 1 } }
    return $count
}
function Get-CodeOnly([string]$Text) {
    $noBlock = [regex]::Replace($Text, "(?s)/\*.*?\*/", "")
    $lines = $noBlock -split "`n"
    $stripped = @()
    foreach ($line in $lines) { $stripped += ($line -replace "//.*$", "") }
    return ($stripped -join "`n")
}
function Get-Occurrences([string]$Text, [string]$Needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
    $count = 0
    $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    while ($index -ge 0) {
        $count = $count + 1
        $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, $index + $Needle.Length, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    }
    return $count
}

$ContractsAnchor = @'
        void Add(string? value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return;
            if (terms.Count >= MaxTerms) return;
            var trimmed = value.Trim();
            if (trimmed.Length > MaxTermLength) trimmed = trimmed.Substring(0, MaxTermLength);
            terms.Add(trimmed);
        }

        Add(Route);
        Add(PageCode);
        Add(WidgetCode);
        foreach (var selection in Selections ?? Array.Empty<string>()) Add(selection);
        foreach (var filter in Filters ?? Array.Empty<string>()) Add(filter);

        return terms;
'@

$ContractsNew = @'
        // Every term is PREFIXED with the kind of hint it is, so ranking can tell
        // a page from a widget and a selection from a filter on the same field.
        // The client sends selections and filters already joined as field=value,
        // because that is the side where the two are still separate and typed.
        void Add(string kind, string? value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) return;
            if (terms.Count >= MaxTerms) return;
            var trimmed = value.Trim();
            if (trimmed.Length > MaxTermLength) trimmed = trimmed.Substring(0, MaxTermLength);
            terms.Add(kind + ":" + trimmed);
        }

        Add("route", Route);
        Add("page", PageCode);
        Add("widget", WidgetCode);
        foreach (var selection in Selections ?? Array.Empty<string>()) Add("selection", selection);
        foreach (var filter in Filters ?? Array.Empty<string>()) Add("filter", filter);

        return terms;
'@

        var terms = new AssistantContextEnvelope(PageCode: "PAGE_ALPHA", Selections: selections).RetrievalTerms();

$BackTestNew3 = @'
    [Fact]
    public void A_client_cannot_stuff_the_embedded_text()
    {
        var selections = Enumerable.Range(0, 200).Select(i => new string('x', 400) + i).ToArray();
        var terms = new AssistantContextEnvelope(PageCode: "PAGE_ALPHA", Selections: selections).RetrievalTerms();

        Assert.True(terms.Count <= 24);
        /* The cap applies to the VALUE; the kind prefix is added after it, so the
           term is the value cap plus a short prefix and never unbounded. */
        Assert.All(terms, t => Assert.True(t.Substring(t.IndexOf(':') + 1).Length <= 120));
        Assert.All(terms, t => Assert.Contains(':', t));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_selection_and_a_filter_on_the_same_field_are_distinguishable()
    {
        var (service, index, _) = Build();

        await service.AskAsync(
            Ask("what does this chart show", new AssistantContextEnvelope(
                Selections: new[] { "grade=DX51D" },
                Filters: new[] { "grade=DX51D" })),
            null, CancellationToken.None);

        var terms = index.LastQuery!.ContextTerms!;
        Assert.Contains("selection:grade=DX51D", terms);
        Assert.Contains("filter:grade=DX51D", terms);
        /* Two hints of different kinds on the same field, and the ranking layer
           can tell them apart. Before this correction both were "grade:DX51D". */
        Assert.Equal(2, terms.Count);
    }

Write-Line "OK    tsc clean and the frontend suite green"

<#
    PPIQ pack: apply-T-073-01-widget-result-evidence-table

    T-073 step 1 of 3, under the option A ruling. One concern: the persisted
    evidence snapshot a WidgetResult citation resolves to.

    Nothing in this pack touches C#. It adds one numbered SQL script and its row
    in the apply-order manifest, so the definition is in the replay chain and
    exists nowhere as live-only SQL.

    Measured before writing:
      - The replay chain is `deploy/scripts/ci-test-db.sh`, which runs the EF
        idempotent script and then EVERY Backend/database/scripts/*.sql in
        filename order. So a numbered script IS the chain; the manifest is the
        classification register beside it.
      - canon.assistant_chunk lives in 420_phase6_assistant.sql and assumes the
        canon schema already exists (320, 400, 420_p3, 421, 430 each create it).
        This script creates it defensively so it can never depend on order.
      - The neighbouring assistant table carries tenant_id and is filtered by an
        explicit SQL predicate rather than RLS. This table follows that pattern
        exactly - inventing a different tenant mechanism next to it would be the
        inconsistency, not the safety.
      - The highest existing script is 770_t039_definition_version_store.sql, so
        780 is the next free number and sorts after everything it depends on.

    The shape, and why each column has to be there:
      tenant_id                the isolation predicate
      page_code, widget_code   which surface and which widget the claim is about
      widget_definition_id     the definition identity when the producer has it
      query_fingerprint        stable identity of the resolved query
      generated_at_utc         when the result was produced
      filter_context_json      the applied filter and time context
      population_count         the population the claim is over
      result_json              the exact normalised returned result
      result_fingerprint       deterministic hash of the normalised result

    UNIQUE (tenant_id, result_fingerprint) is the mechanism that satisfies
    validation point 6: an unchanged reindex re-derives the same fingerprint,
    conflicts, and REUSES the existing evidence id, so the numeric evidence
    identity does not drift merely because the reindex was repeated.

    Contract: preflight -> report -> backup -> apply -> on-disk self-check ->
    gate -> auto-revert on failure. Report-only by default.
    THE GATE IS PSQL: the script is executed twice against ppiq_presentation to
    prove it is idempotent, and the table is then inspected. Nothing is built,
    so the API may stay running.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$Apply,
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$Revert
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$PackId       = "T-073-01-widget-result-evidence-table"

$BackupRoot   = Join-Path $RepoRootPath ("tools\packs\_backup_" + $PackId + "_" + $Stamp)

$ManifestMdPath  = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\database\database.apply-order.manifest.md"
$EnvFile         = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "env\profiles\presentation.env"

function Write-Line([string]$Text) { Write-Host $Text }
function Write-Head([string]$Text) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
    Write-Host $Text
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
}

function Get-FileText([string]$Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }
function Set-FileText([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}
function Get-NewlineConvention([string]$Text) {
    if ($Text.Contains("`r`n")) { return "CRLF" } else { return "LF" }
}
function ConvertTo-Convention([string]$Text, [string]$Convention) {
    $flat = $Text -replace "`r", ""
    if ($Convention -eq "CRLF") { return ($flat -replace "`n", "`r`n") }
    return $flat
}
function Get-NonAsciiCount([string]$Text) {
    $count = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 127) { $count = $count + 1 } }
    return $count
}
function Get-Occurrences([string]$Text, [string]$Needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
    $count = 0
    $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    while ($index -ge 0) {
        $count = $count + 1
        $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, $index + $Needle.Length, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    }
    return $count
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The new script
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

$SqlText = @'
\set ON_ERROR_STOP on

-- ============================================================================
-- PlantProcess IQ
-- 780_t073_widget_result_evidence.sql
--
-- T-073. The persisted evidence snapshot that a WidgetResult citation resolves
-- to. Idempotent and generic: no page, widget, industry or plant vocabulary
-- appears anywhere in this file, because the rows are produced by executing
-- whatever widgets the installation actually defines.
--
-- Why this table exists at all: a Dataset handle proves a table or view exists.
-- It does NOT prove that a particular widget returned a particular number under
-- a particular filter over a particular population. Nothing already persisted
-- carries that, so a numeric assistant claim had no artifact to resolve to.
--
-- The unique constraint is load bearing. The producer derives
-- result_fingerprint deterministically from the normalised result and the query
-- identity, then inserts ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. An unchanged reindex therefore
-- REUSES the existing evidence id rather than minting a new one, so a citation
-- stays valid and the numeric evidence identity does not drift.
--
-- Tenant safety follows canon.assistant_chunk exactly: an explicit tenant_id
-- column, filtered by predicate at every read. That is the pattern the
-- neighbouring assistant table already uses.
-- ============================================================================

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS canon;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS canon.assistant_widget_result (
    id                   uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id            uuid        NOT NULL,
    page_code            text        NOT NULL,
    widget_code          text        NOT NULL,
    widget_definition_id uuid        NULL,
    query_fingerprint    text        NOT NULL,
    generated_at_utc     timestamptz NOT NULL,
    filter_context_json  jsonb       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    population_count     integer     NOT NULL,
    result_json          jsonb       NOT NULL,
    result_fingerprint   text        NOT NULL,
    created_at_utc       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT uq_assistant_widget_result UNIQUE (tenant_id, result_fingerprint),
    CONSTRAINT ck_assistant_widget_result_population CHECK (population_count >= 0)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_assistant_widget_result_tenant_widget
    ON canon.assistant_widget_result (tenant_id, widget_code);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_assistant_widget_result_tenant_page
    ON canon.assistant_widget_result (tenant_id, page_code);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_assistant_widget_result_generated
    ON canon.assistant_widget_result (tenant_id, generated_at_utc DESC);

COMMENT ON TABLE canon.assistant_widget_result IS
    'T-073: exact widget execution snapshot a WidgetResult provenance handle resolves to. One row per distinct (tenant, result fingerprint).';
'@

$ManifestRow = '"780","30_schema","APP_SCHEMA_CANDIDATE","AUTO_APPLY_CANDIDATE","ApplicationDbDeploy","GenericProductSchema","LOW","Script","Backend\database\scripts\780_t073_widget_result_evidence.sql","0","0","T-073 widget result evidence snapshot; idempotent, tenant scoped"'

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Revert
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

if ($Revert) {
    Write-Head "REVERT $PackId"
    $candidates = Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $RepoRootPath "tools\packs") -Directory -Filter "_backup_$PackId*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($null -eq $candidates -or $candidates.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Line "FAIL  no backup folder found for $PackId"
        exit 1
    }
    $latest = $candidates | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object -Last 1

    foreach ($pair in @(
        @{ Name = "database.apply-order.manifest.csv"; Target = $ManifestCsvPath },
        @{ Name = "database.apply-order.manifest.md";  Target = $ManifestMdPath })) {
        $saved = Join-Path $latest.FullName $pair.Name
        if (Test-Path $saved) {
            Set-FileText $pair.Target (Get-FileText $saved)
            Write-Line ("OK    restored " + $pair.Name)
        }
    }

    if (Test-Path $ScriptPath) {
        Remove-Item $ScriptPath -Force
        Write-Line "OK    removed 780_t073_widget_result_evidence.sql"
    }

    Write-Line ""
    Write-Line "NOTE  the TABLE is not dropped. Removing product data is not a pack's"
    Write-Line "      decision. If you want it gone from ppiq_presentation:"
    Write-Line "        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS canon.assistant_widget_result;"
    exit 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Preflight
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Write-Head "PREFLIGHT $PackId"

if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Jenkinsfile"))) {
    Write-Line "FAIL  run this pack from the repository root: cd C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ"
    exit 1
}
Write-Line "OK    repository root: $RepoRootPath"

if (Test-Path $ScriptPath) {
    Write-Line "FAIL  780_t073_widget_result_evidence.sql already exists - this pack has been applied"
    exit 1
}
foreach ($path in @($ManifestCsvPath, $ManifestMdPath)) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $path)) {
        Write-Line "FAIL  manifest not found: $path"
        exit 1
    }
}

$ManifestCsvText = Get-FileText $ManifestCsvPath
$ManifestMdText  = Get-FileText $ManifestMdPath
$ManifestCsvConv = Get-NewlineConvention $ManifestCsvText
$ManifestMdConv  = Get-NewlineConvention $ManifestMdText

Write-Line ("      manifest csv  lines " + (($ManifestCsvText -split "`n").Count) + "  " + $ManifestCsvConv)
Write-Line ("      manifest md   lines " + (($ManifestMdText -split "`n").Count) + "  " + $ManifestMdConv)

if ((Get-Occurrences $ManifestCsvText "780_t073_widget_result_evidence") -gt 0) {
    Write-Line "FAIL  the manifest already carries this script"
    exit 1
}

# 780 must be free and must be the highest, or the apply order is not what the
# comment claims.
$Existing = Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\database\scripts") -Filter "*.sql" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$Numbered = @($Existing | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d{3}_' })
$Highest  = ($Numbered | ForEach-Object { [int]$_.Name.Substring(0, 3) } | Sort-Object | Select-Object -Last 1)
Write-Line ("      numbered scripts: " + $Numbered.Count + ", highest number: " + $Highest)
if ($Highest -ge 780) {
    Write-Line "FAIL  780 is not free - re-number this script before applying"
    exit 1
}
Write-Line "OK    780 is free and sorts last"

# Credentials for the gate, read from the profile rather than typed anywhere.
$PgHost = "127.0.0.1"; $PgPort = "5432"; $PgUser = $null; $PgPass = $null; $PgDb = "ppiq_presentation"
if (Test-Path $EnvFile) {
    foreach ($line in (Get-Content $EnvFile)) {
        if ($line -match '^\s*#') { continue }
        if ($line -match 'POSTGRES_USER\s*=\s*(.+)$')     { $PgUser = $matches[1].Trim() }
        if ($line -match 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD\s*=\s*(.+)$') { $PgPass = $matches[1].Trim() }
        if ($line -match 'POSTGRES_DB\s*=\s*(.+)$')       { $PgDb   = $matches[1].Trim() }
    }
}
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($PgUser)) { $PgUser = "ppiq_dev" }
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($PgPass)) { $PgPass = "ppiq_dev_local_only" }
Write-Line ("OK    gate target: " + $PgDb + " as " + $PgUser + " on " + $PgHost + ":" + $PgPort)

$PsqlAvailable = $null -ne (Get-Command psql -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
if (-not $PsqlAvailable) {
    Write-Line "WARN  psql is not on PATH. The file will be written and checked on disk,"
    Write-Line "      but the idempotency gate cannot run here. Run the script yourself."
}

if ($ReportOnly -or (-not $Apply)) {
    Write-Head "REPORT ONLY - nothing was written"
    Write-Line "Would create : Backend\database\scripts\780_t073_widget_result_evidence.sql"
    Write-Line "Would append : one row to both apply-order manifests"
    Write-Line ""
    Write-Line "Re-run with -Apply to make the change."
    exit 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup and apply
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Write-Head "BACKUP"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupRoot -Force | Out-Null
Set-FileText (Join-Path $BackupRoot "database.apply-order.manifest.csv") $ManifestCsvText
Set-FileText (Join-Path $BackupRoot "database.apply-order.manifest.md")  $ManifestMdText
Write-Line "OK    both manifests copied to $BackupRoot"

Write-Head "APPLY"

# The scripts directory is LF by convention for psql portability; the file is
# written LF regardless of what the manifests use.
Set-FileText $ScriptPath (ConvertTo-Convention $SqlText "LF")
Write-Line "OK    Backend\database\scripts\780_t073_widget_result_evidence.sql"

$CsvSeparator = if ($ManifestCsvConv -eq "CRLF") { "`r`n" } else { "`n" }
$CsvBody = $ManifestCsvText.TrimEnd("`r", "`n")
Set-FileText $ManifestCsvPath ($CsvBody + $CsvSeparator + $ManifestRow + $CsvSeparator)
Write-Line "OK    manifest csv row appended"

$MdSeparator = if ($ManifestMdConv -eq "CRLF") { "`r`n" } else { "`n" }
$MdBody = $ManifestMdText.TrimEnd("`r", "`n")
$MdNote = "- 780 / 30_schema / APP_SCHEMA_CANDIDATE - Backend\database\scripts\780_t073_widget_result_evidence.sql - T-073 widget result evidence snapshot; idempotent, tenant scoped."
Set-FileText $ManifestMdPath ($MdBody + $MdSeparator + $MdSeparator + $MdNote + $MdSeparator)
Write-Line "OK    manifest md note appended"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# On-disk self-check
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

Write-Head "SELF-CHECK (read back from disk)"

$Failures = @()
$DiskSql  = Get-FileText $ScriptPath
$DiskCsv  = Get-FileText $ManifestCsvPath
$DiskMd   = Get-FileText $ManifestMdPath

if ((Get-Occurrences $DiskSql "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS canon.assistant_widget_result") -ne 1) { $Failures += "the table statement is not present once" }
if ((Get-Occurrences $DiskSql "CONSTRAINT uq_assistant_widget_result UNIQUE (tenant_id, result_fingerprint)") -ne 1) { $Failures += "the fingerprint uniqueness is missing" }
if ((Get-Occurrences $DiskSql "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS canon;") -ne 1) { $Failures += "the schema guard is missing" }
foreach ($column in @("tenant_id", "page_code", "widget_code", "widget_definition_id", "query_fingerprint",
                      "generated_at_utc", "filter_context_json", "population_count", "result_json", "result_fingerprint")) {
    if ((Get-Occurrences $DiskSql $column) -lt 1) { $Failures += "column missing: $column" }
}
if ((Get-Occurrences $DiskSql "DROP TABLE") -ne 0)  { $Failures += "the script drops something" }
if ((Get-Occurrences $DiskSql "TRUNCATE") -ne 0)    { $Failures += "the script truncates something" }
if ((Get-Occurrences $DiskSql "DELETE FROM") -ne 0) { $Failures += "the script deletes rows" }

# Rule 1: nothing plant, industry or demo specific may appear in a generic table.
foreach ($banned in @("heat", "coil", "slab", "steel", "caster", "meltshop", "DX51D", "EAF", "HSM", "defect_type")) {
    if ($DiskSql.ToLowerInvariant().Contains($banned.ToLowerInvariant())) { $Failures += "plant or demo vocabulary in a generic script: $banned" }
}

if ((Get-Occurrences $DiskCsv "780_t073_widget_result_evidence.sql") -ne 1) { $Failures += "the csv manifest row is missing" }
if ((Get-Occurrences $DiskMd  "780_t073_widget_result_evidence.sql") -ne 1) { $Failures += "the md manifest note is missing" }
if ((Get-NonAsciiCount $DiskSql) -ne 0) { $Failures += "non-ASCII in the new script" }
if ((Get-NewlineConvention $DiskCsv) -ne $ManifestCsvConv) { $Failures += "the csv manifest line endings changed" }
if ((Get-NewlineConvention $DiskMd)  -ne $ManifestMdConv)  { $Failures += "the md manifest line endings changed" }

function Restore-All {
    Set-FileText $ManifestCsvPath $ManifestCsvText
    Set-FileText $ManifestMdPath  $ManifestMdText
    if (Test-Path $ScriptPath) { Remove-Item $ScriptPath -Force }
}

if ($Failures.Count -gt 0) {
    foreach ($f in $Failures) { Write-Line "FAIL  $f" }
    Write-Line ""
    Restore-All
    Write-Line "OK    reverted; backup remains at $BackupRoot"
    exit 1
}

Write-Line "OK    table, uniqueness and schema guard present"
Write-Line "OK    every required column present, nothing destructive in the script"
Write-Line "OK    no plant, industry or demo vocabulary, no non-ASCII"
Write-Line "OK    both manifests carry the script exactly once"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Gate: run it TWICE. Idempotency is the claim, so it is what gets proved.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (-not $PsqlAvailable) {
    Write-Head "GATE SKIPPED - psql is not on PATH"
    Write-Line "The files are written and checked. Run this yourself before committing:"
    Write-Line ""
    Write-Line "  `$env:PGPASSWORD = '<password>'"
    Write-Line "  psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U $PgUser -d $PgDb -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f Backend\database\scripts\780_t073_widget_result_evidence.sql"
    Write-Line ""
    Write-Line "Twice. The second run must be as silent as the first."
    exit 0
}

Write-Head "GATE 1 of 2 - apply the script twice"

$env:PGPASSWORD = $PgPass

& psql -h $PgHost -p $PgPort -U $PgUser -d $PgDb -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f $ScriptPath
$FirstExit = $LASTEXITCODE

if ($FirstExit -ne 0) {
    Write-Line "FAIL  first application exited $FirstExit"
    Restore-All
    Write-Line "OK    reverted; backup remains at $BackupRoot"
    exit 1
}
Write-Line "OK    first application clean"

& psql -h $PgHost -p $PgPort -U $PgUser -d $PgDb -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f $ScriptPath
$SecondExit = $LASTEXITCODE

if ($SecondExit -ne 0) {
    Write-Line "FAIL  second application exited $SecondExit - the script is NOT idempotent"
    Write-Line "      The table may now exist. Inspect before re-running."
    Restore-All
    Write-Line "OK    files reverted; backup remains at $BackupRoot"
    exit 1
}
Write-Line "OK    second application clean - idempotent"

Write-Head "GATE 2 of 2 - inspect what was created"

$Inspect = @"
SELECT 'columns=' || count(*)::text
  FROM information_schema.columns
 WHERE table_schema = 'canon' AND table_name = 'assistant_widget_result';
SELECT 'unique=' || count(*)::text
  FROM pg_constraint
 WHERE conname = 'uq_assistant_widget_result';
SELECT 'indexes=' || count(*)::text
  FROM pg_indexes
 WHERE schemaname = 'canon' AND tablename = 'assistant_widget_result';
SELECT 'rows=' || count(*)::text FROM canon.assistant_widget_result;
"@

$InspectFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("ppiq-t073-inspect-" + $Stamp + ".sql")
Set-FileText $InspectFile $Inspect

& psql -h $PgHost -p $PgPort -U $PgUser -d $PgDb -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -t -A -f $InspectFile
$InspectExit = $LASTEXITCODE
Remove-Item $InspectFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

if ($InspectExit -ne 0) {
    Write-Line "FAIL  inspection exited $InspectExit"
    Restore-All
    Write-Line "OK    reverted; backup remains at $BackupRoot"
    exit 1
}

Write-Line ""
Write-Line "Expected above: columns=12, unique=1, indexes=4, rows=0"
Write-Line "Four indexes because the primary key counts as one."

Write-Head "DONE"
Write-Line "Added  : Backend\database\scripts\780_t073_widget_result_evidence.sql"
Write-Line "Changed: database.apply-order.manifest.csv, database.apply-order.manifest.md"
Write-Line "Backup : $BackupRoot"
Write-Line ""
Write-Line "Step 2 adds the WidgetResult provenance kind and its resolver branch."
exit 0

function Get-NonAsciiCount([string]$Text) {
    $count = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 127) { $count = $count + 1 } }
    return $count
}
function Get-Occurrences([string]$Text, [string]$Needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
    $count = 0
    $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    while ($index -ge 0) {
        $count = $count + 1
        $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, $index + $Needle.Length, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    }
    return $count
}

$SqlText = @'
\set ON_ERROR_STOP on

-- ============================================================================
-- PlantProcess IQ
-- 780_t073_widget_result_evidence.sql
--
-- T-073. The persisted evidence snapshot that a WidgetResult citation resolves
-- to. Idempotent and generic: no page, widget, industry or plant vocabulary
-- appears anywhere in this file, because the rows are produced by executing
-- whatever widgets the installation actually defines.
--
-- Why this table exists at all: a Dataset handle proves a table or view exists.
-- It does NOT prove that a particular widget returned a particular number under
-- a particular filter over a particular population. Nothing already persisted
-- carries that, so a numeric assistant claim had no artifact to resolve to.
--
-- The unique constraint is load bearing. The producer derives
-- result_fingerprint deterministically from the normalised result and the query
-- identity, then inserts ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. An unchanged reindex therefore
-- REUSES the existing evidence id rather than minting a new one, so a citation
-- stays valid and the numeric evidence identity does not drift.
--
-- Tenant safety follows canon.assistant_chunk exactly: an explicit tenant_id
-- column, filtered by predicate at every read. That is the pattern the
-- neighbouring assistant table already uses.
-- ============================================================================

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS canon;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS canon.assistant_widget_result (
    id                   uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    tenant_id            uuid        NOT NULL,
    page_code            text        NOT NULL,
    widget_code          text        NOT NULL,
    widget_definition_id uuid        NULL,
    query_fingerprint    text        NOT NULL,
    generated_at_utc     timestamptz NOT NULL,
    filter_context_json  jsonb       NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    population_count     integer     NOT NULL,
    result_json          jsonb       NOT NULL,
    result_fingerprint   text        NOT NULL,
    created_at_utc       timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT uq_assistant_widget_result UNIQUE (tenant_id, result_fingerprint),
    CONSTRAINT ck_assistant_widget_result_population CHECK (population_count >= 0)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_assistant_widget_result_tenant_widget
    ON canon.assistant_widget_result (tenant_id, widget_code);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_assistant_widget_result_tenant_page
    ON canon.assistant_widget_result (tenant_id, page_code);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_assistant_widget_result_generated
    ON canon.assistant_widget_result (tenant_id, generated_at_utc DESC);

COMMENT ON TABLE canon.assistant_widget_result IS
    'T-073: exact widget execution snapshot a WidgetResult provenance handle resolves to. One row per distinct (tenant, result fingerprint).';
'@

<#
    PPIQ pack: apply-T-073-02-widget-result-provenance-kind

    T-073 step 2 of 3. One concern: a citation of the form WidgetResult:<id>
    resolves against the snapshot table that step 1 created.

    Measured before writing:
      - ProvenanceKind carries five members and NpgsqlProvenanceResolver
        switches on all five with a Missing default, failing CLOSED so an
        unverifiable claim is never rendered.
      - ResolveDocumentAsync already guards with to_regclass before touching a
        table that may not be installed. The new branch copies that pattern
        rather than inventing one.
      - The new member is APPENDED to the enum. Inserting it anywhere else
        would renumber the existing members, and nothing in the tree guarantees
        no ordinal of this enum was ever persisted.

    What this pack deliberately does NOT do: return snapshot CONTENT.
    IProvenanceResolver.ResolveAsync takes a handle and no tenant, exactly as it
    does for every existing kind, and returns existence plus an artifact
    reference. Content stays behind the tenant-filtered read paths. Validation
    point 4 - recovering the exact snapshot behind a citation - therefore needs
    a tenant-scoped read, and that arrives in step 3 with the tenant taken from
    claims. Widening this interface to carry a tenant would touch every existing
    kind and is not T-073's business.

    Contract: preflight -> report -> anchor verify with diagnosis -> backup ->
    apply -> on-disk self-check -> gate -> auto-revert on failure.
    Report-only by default. The API must be stopped: this pack builds.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$Apply,
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$Revert
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$PackId       = "T-073-02-widget-result-provenance-kind"
$RepoRootPath = (Get-Location).Path
$Stamp        = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$BackupRoot   = Join-Path $RepoRootPath ("tools\packs\_backup_" + $PackId + "_" + $Stamp)

$HandlePath    = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\PlantProcess.Application\Provenance\ProvenanceHandle.cs"
$ResolverPath  = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure\Provenance\NpgsqlProvenanceResolver.cs"
$UnitTestPath  = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Application.UnitTests\Provenance\T073WidgetResultHandleTests.cs"
$ArchTestPath  = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests\ProvenanceResolverExhaustivenessTests.cs"

function Write-Line([string]$Text) { Write-Host $Text }
function Write-Head([string]$Text) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
    Write-Host $Text
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
}

function Get-FileText([string]$Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }
function Set-FileText([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}
function Get-NewlineConvention([string]$Text) {
    if ($Text.Contains("`r`n")) { return "CRLF" } else { return "LF" }
}
function ConvertTo-Convention([string]$Text, [string]$Convention) {
    $flat = $Text -replace "`r", ""
    if ($Convention -eq "CRLF") { return ($flat -replace "`n", "`r`n") }
    return $flat
}
function Get-NonAsciiCount([string]$Text) {
    $count = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 127) { $count = $count + 1 } }
    return $count
}
function Get-CodeOnly([string]$Text) {
    $noBlock = [regex]::Replace($Text, "(?s)/\*.*?\*/", "")
    $lines = $noBlock -split "`n"
    $stripped = @()
    foreach ($line in $lines) { $stripped += ($line -replace "//.*$", "") }
    return ($stripped -join "`n")
}
function Get-Occurrences([string]$Text, [string]$Needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
    $count = 0
    $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    while ($index -ge 0) {
        $count = $count + 1
        $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, $index + $Needle.Length, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    }
    return $count
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Edits
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

$HandleAnchor1 = @'
public enum ProvenanceKind
{
    Finding,
    JobRun,
    Dataset,
    SourceTable,
    DocumentSection
}
'@

$HandleNew1 = @'
public enum ProvenanceKind
{
    Finding,
    JobRun,
    Dataset,
    SourceTable,
    DocumentSection,

    /// <summary>
    /// T-073. One exact widget execution: which widget returned which values,
    /// under which filter, over which population, at which moment.
    ///
    /// It exists because Dataset cannot do this job. A Dataset handle proves a
    /// table or view exists; it says nothing about whether a particular widget
    /// returned a particular number. A citation that resolves green while
    /// proving the wrong thing is worse than no citation.
    ///
    /// APPENDED, never inserted: moving it would renumber the members above.
    /// </summary>
    WidgetResult
}
'@

$HandleAnchor2 = @'
    public static ProvenanceHandle DocumentSection(string id, string? detail = null) => new(ProvenanceKind.DocumentSection, id, detail);
'@

$HandleNew2 = @'
    public static ProvenanceHandle DocumentSection(string id, string? detail = null) => new(ProvenanceKind.DocumentSection, id, detail);
    public static ProvenanceHandle WidgetResult(string id, string? detail = null) => new(ProvenanceKind.WidgetResult, id, detail);
'@

$ResolverAnchor1 = @'
                ProvenanceKind.DocumentSection                  => await ResolveDocumentAsync(handle, cancellationToken),
'@

$ResolverNew1 = @'
                ProvenanceKind.DocumentSection                  => await ResolveDocumentAsync(handle, cancellationToken),
                ProvenanceKind.WidgetResult                     => await ResolveWidgetResultAsync(handle, cancellationToken),
'@

$ResolverAnchor2 = @'
        await using var cmd = _dataSource.CreateCommand("SELECT 1 FROM public.document_sections WHERE id::text = @id");
        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("id", handle.Id);
        return await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync(ct) is not null
            ? ProvenanceResolution.Live(handle, $"document_sections:{handle.Id}")
            : ProvenanceResolution.Missing(handle, "Document section was not found.");
    }
'@

$ResolverNew2 = @'
        await using var cmd = _dataSource.CreateCommand("SELECT 1 FROM public.document_sections WHERE id::text = @id");
        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("id", handle.Id);
        return await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync(ct) is not null
            ? ProvenanceResolution.Live(handle, $"document_sections:{handle.Id}")
            : ProvenanceResolution.Missing(handle, "Document section was not found.");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// T-073. Resolves one exact widget execution snapshot.
    ///
    /// Existence only, and that is deliberate: this method returns an artifact
    /// reference, never the snapshot's rows. Content is reachable solely through
    /// the tenant-filtered read paths, because this interface carries no tenant
    /// for any kind. Fails CLOSED like every other branch.
    /// </summary>
    private async Task<ProvenanceResolution> ResolveWidgetResultAsync(ProvenanceHandle handle, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (!Guid.TryParse(handle.Id, out var id))
            return ProvenanceResolution.Missing(handle, "Widget result id is not a GUID.");

        await using (var existsCmd = _dataSource.CreateCommand("SELECT to_regclass('canon.assistant_widget_result') IS NOT NULL"))
        {
            var available = await existsCmd.ExecuteScalarAsync(ct) as bool? ?? false;
            if (!available)
                return ProvenanceResolution.Missing(handle, "Widget result evidence store is not installed.");
        }

        await using var cmd = _dataSource.CreateCommand(
            "SELECT result_fingerprint FROM canon.assistant_widget_result WHERE id = @id");
        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("id", id);

        var fingerprint = await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync(ct) as string;

        return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fingerprint)
            ? ProvenanceResolution.Missing(handle, "No widget result snapshot matched the handle.")
            : ProvenanceResolution.Live(handle, $"assistant_widget_result:{id}");
    }
'@

$UnitTestText = @'
using PlantProcess.Application.Provenance;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Application.UnitTests.Provenance;

/// <summary>
/// T-073. The handle a numeric assistant claim cites.

public class T073WidgetResultHandleTests

    [Fact]
    public void The_kind_exists_and_is_appended_last()
    {
        var members = Enum.GetNames<ProvenanceKind>();

        Assert.Contains("WidgetResult", members);

using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

/// <summary>
/// T-073. Every provenance kind must have a real resolver branch.
///
/// The resolver's switch ends in a default that returns Missing, so a kind added
/// without a branch does not break the build - it silently becomes unresolvable,
/// and a citation of that kind would refuse forever with no obvious cause. This
/// reads both source files textually, so it needs no project reference and
/// cannot be satisfied by a comment.
/// </summary>
[Trait("Gate", "ProvenanceResolverExhaustiveness")]
public sealed class ProvenanceResolverExhaustivenessTests
{
    private static string Read(string relativePath)
        => File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(PipelineSourceText.RepoRoot(), relativePath));

        => PipelineSourceText.StripComments(
            Read(Path.Combine("Backend", "PlantProcess.Infrastructure", "Provenance", "NpgsqlProvenanceResolver.cs")));

    private static string[] DeclaredKinds()
    {
        var source = PipelineSourceText.StripComments(
            Read(Path.Combine("Backend", "PlantProcess.Application", "Provenance", "ProvenanceHandle.cs")));

        var match = Regex.Match(source, @"enum\s+ProvenanceKind\s*\{(?<body>[^}]*)\}", RegexOptions.Singleline);
        Assert.True(match.Success, "Could not locate the ProvenanceKind declaration.");

        return match.Groups["body"].Value
            .Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries)

            .ToArray();

<#
    PPIQ pack: apply-T-073-03a-widget-result-chunk-producer

    T-073 step 3a of 3. One concern: real widget results become persisted
    evidence snapshots, and the retrieval chunks are built FROM those snapshots.

    THE CHAIN, exactly as ruled:
        discover widgets read-only from the definition tables
     -> execute each ONCE through the existing IDashboardWidgetQueryService
     -> normalise the actual returned result
     -> PERSIST the snapshot
     -> read the persisted row back
     -> build the chunk sentence FROM THE PERSISTED REPRESENTATION
     -> chunk source_ref IS the snapshot id, so the citation is
        WidgetResult:<evidence-id> and the step-2 resolver resolves it.

    A FINDING THAT SHAPED THIS PACK, and it would have silently defeated the
    ruling: NpgsqlRetrievalIndex.SearchAsync does NOT store the producer's
    handle. It rebuilds one at search time with HandleFor(kind, sourceRef),
    whose default arm is ProvenanceHandle.Dataset(sourceRef). A chunk produced
    with a correct WidgetResult handle would therefore have reached the
    assistant as a Dataset citation - the substitution the ruling explicitly
    rejects, reintroduced by the retrieval layer. HandleFor now maps the kind,
    and because source_ref is the snapshot id the rebuilt handle resolves.

    DESIGN, and why it is not a constructor change to CanonicalChunkProducer:
    a composite. CanonicalChunkProducer is untouched, so nothing that already
    works can regress, and the class that already reads the canonical substrate
    does not acquire a dependency on dashboard execution. The composite is the
    registered IAssistantChunkProducer and runs both.

    The PURE logic - normalisation, both fingerprints and the sentence - lives
    in Application with no IO, so it is unit tested without a database. The
    Infrastructure producer only discovers, executes, persists and reads back.

    DETERMINISM: neither fingerprint includes the generation timestamp, and
    neither does the sentence. An unchanged reindex therefore re-derives the
    same result_fingerprint, conflicts on the unique constraint, and REUSES the
    existing evidence id. The timestamp is still recorded in the snapshot and is
    recoverable through the handle.

    Contract: preflight -> report -> anchor verify -> backup -> apply ->
    on-disk self-check -> gate -> auto-revert on failure.
    Report-only by default. The API must be stopped: this pack builds.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$Apply,
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$Revert
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"

$PackId       = "T-073-03a-widget-result-chunk-producer"
$RepoRootPath = (Get-Location).Path
$Stamp        = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$BackupRoot   = Join-Path $RepoRootPath ("tools\packs\_backup_" + $PackId + "_" + $Stamp)

$IndexPath      = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure\Assistant\NpgsqlRetrievalIndex.cs"
$DiPath         = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure\Assistant\AssistantInfrastructureExtensions.cs"
$EvidencePath   = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\PlantProcess.Application\Assistant\WidgetResultEvidence.cs"
$ProducerPath   = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure\Assistant\WidgetResultChunkProducer.cs"
$CompositePath  = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\PlantProcess.Infrastructure\Assistant\CompositeChunkProducer.cs"
$TestPath       = Join-Path $RepoRootPath "Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Application.UnitTests\Assistant\T073WidgetResultEvidenceTests.cs"

function Write-Line([string]$Text) { Write-Host $Text }
function Write-Head([string]$Text) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
    Write-Host $Text
    Write-Host ("-" * 78)
}

function Get-FileText([string]$Path) { return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) }
function Set-FileText([string]$Path, [string]$Text) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}
function Get-NewlineConvention([string]$Text) {
    if ($Text.Contains("`r`n")) { return "CRLF" } else { return "LF" }
}
function ConvertTo-Convention([string]$Text, [string]$Convention) {
    $flat = $Text -replace "`r", ""
    if ($Convention -eq "CRLF") { return ($flat -replace "`n", "`r`n") }
    return $flat
}
function Get-NonAsciiCount([string]$Text) {
    $count = 0
    foreach ($ch in $Text.ToCharArray()) { if ([int]$ch -gt 127) { $count = $count + 1 } }
    return $count
}
function Get-CodeOnly([string]$Text) {
    $noBlock = [regex]::Replace($Text, "(?s)/\*.*?\*/", "")
    $lines = $noBlock -split "`n"
    $stripped = @()
    foreach ($line in $lines) { $stripped += ($line -replace "//.*$", "") }
    return ($stripped -join "`n")
}
function Get-Occurrences([string]$Text, [string]$Needle) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($Needle)) { return 0 }
    $count = 0
    $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    while ($index -ge 0) {
        $count = $count + 1
        $index = $Text.IndexOf($Needle, $index + $Needle.Length, [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    }
    return $count
}

$IndexAnchor = @'
        "finding" => ProvenanceHandle.Finding(sourceRef),
        "report"  => ProvenanceHandle.DocumentSection(sourceRef),
        "doc"     => ProvenanceHandle.DocumentSection(sourceRef),
        _         => ProvenanceHandle.Dataset(sourceRef)
'@

$IndexNew = @'
        "finding" => ProvenanceHandle.Finding(sourceRef),
        "report"  => ProvenanceHandle.DocumentSection(sourceRef),
        "doc"     => ProvenanceHandle.DocumentSection(sourceRef),

        // T-073. Without this arm a widget-result chunk would arrive at the
        // assistant carrying a DATASET citation, because this method rebuilds the
        // handle at search time and ignores the one the producer created. A
        // Dataset handle proves a table exists; it cannot prove a widget returned
        // a number. The source_ref of this kind IS the snapshot id, so the
        // rebuilt handle resolves against canon.assistant_widget_result.
        "widgetresult" => ProvenanceHandle.WidgetResult(sourceRef),

        _         => ProvenanceHandle.Dataset(sourceRef)
'@

$DiAnchor = @'
        services.AddScoped<IAssistantChunkProducer, CanonicalChunkProducer>();
'@

$DiNew = @'
        // T-073. The registered producer is a COMPOSITE. CanonicalChunkProducer is
        // untouched and keeps its five families; the widget-result family is a
        // separate class, so the type that reads the canonical substrate does not
        // acquire a dependency on dashboard execution.
        services.AddScoped<CanonicalChunkProducer>();
        services.AddScoped<WidgetResultChunkProducer>();
        services.AddScoped<IAssistantChunkProducer, CompositeChunkProducer>();
'@
